Name: Roche
Description:
Roche is a global pioneer in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics focused on advancing science to improve people’s lives. The combined strengths of pharmaceuticals and diagnostics under one roof have made Roche the leader in personalised healthcare – a strategy that aims to fit the right treatment to each patient in the best way possible.

Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in in vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management.

Founded in 1896, Roche continues to search for better ways to prevent, diagnose and treat diseases and make a sustainable contribution to society. The company also aims to improve patient access to medical innovations by working with all relevant stakeholders. Thirty medicines developed by Roche are included in the World Health Organization Model Lists of Essential Medicines, among them life-saving antibiotics, antimalarials and cancer medicines. Roche has been recognised as the Group Leader in sustainability within the Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology & Life Sciences Industry ten years in a row by the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices (DJSI).

For more information, please visit https://careers.roche.com

Name: Revena
Description: Revena, previously Revenant Bio, is a specialist science and management consultancy with a focus on life science and deep tech. Name: AlveoGene
Description:
AlveoGene is an innovative company focused on transforming rare respiratory disease outcomes using inhaled gene therapy.

AlveoGene has been created by OSE, Harrington and OCC in partnership with six leading scientists from the world-renowned UK Respiratory Gene Therapy Consortium (GTC).

The GTC was founded in 2001 to catalyse the application of pioneering research to gene therapy development and manufacturing related to cystic fibrosis and other respiratory diseases, and originated at Imperial College London and the Universities of Oxford and Edinburgh.

AlveoGene has secured an exclusive licence to a proprietary and validated next-generation lentiviral delivery platform developed by the GTC for the treatment of respiratory diseases with high unmet need (excluding the use of the CFTR gene which is mutated in cystic fibrosis).

Gene therapies developed using our “InGenuiTyTM” platform can be delivered through a nebuliser, transducing lung epithelial cells with high efficiency and producing a long duration of action, and can achieve these effects following repeated administration.

The platform has been developed over more than a decade, supported by approximately £72 million in grant funding, including from the Wellcome Trust, Department of Health and Social Care, Medical Research Council and the Cystic Fibrosis Trust.

Name: Link Biologics
Description:
Link Biologics is pioneering the development of protein biologics that harness the protective biology of TSG-6 and set new standards of care via multi-pathway modulation of inflammation, tissue protection and repair. With broad potential across inflammatory and degenerative conditions, the Company’s lead programmes focus on Dry Eye Disease (DED) and Wet Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD); together these represent multi-billion-dollar global markets with significant unmet needs.

Link Biologics’ approach is validated by its DED programme (LB001) and Wet AMD programme (LB004), which utilises subcutaneous administration rather than intraocular injections. LB004 has been accelerated by leveraging outputs from LB001 alongside robust standalone preclinical data. Both programmes are expected to reach the clinic in 2027 with a clear path to key, value-creating, milestones.

Led by a world-class team with decades of academic and commercial experience in TSG-6 biology and drug development, Link Biologics combines deep scientific and pharma leadership with a collaborative, outcome-driven culture, positioning the Company to deliver game-changing therapies.

Name: Brilliant Dyes
Description: Synthetic dyes used in textiles and cosmetics are linked to skin diseases such as dermatitis, allergic reactions, and eczema. They are also the second-largest contributor to water pollution, leading to biodiversity loss and serious public health risks, including cancer. Consequently, regulatory bodies are advocating for safer, sustainable natural dyes in the food, textile, and cosmetics industries. In many European countries, synthetic dyes are already banned in the food industries. Our innovative, low-cost process for extracting vibrant RGB natural dyes from algae offers a sustainable solution to these challenges, leveraging natural photosynthesis to enable large-scale carbon reduction while meeting industry demands.

Name: Metofico
Description:
At Metofico, we create no-code data analysis software for life science research, helping researchers accelerate discovery with tools that are powerful, practical, and easy to use. Our tools combine AI and data science expertise with intuitive, user-friendly interfaces, making complex analysis more accessible, from automated behaviour recognition and multi-subject tracking to fibre photometry analysis.

We build our tools around the real-world challenges researchers face, with a focus on improving efficiency, reliability, repeatability, and accessibility. Working closely with our collaborators, we continuously refine and adapt our software to ensure it fits a wide range of workflows and research goals.

Name: Tecrea Ltd
Description:
Tecrea Ltd was founded in 2012 as a spin-out of the Royal Veterinary College (University of London), to empower researchers in healthcare and life sciences through our innovation in nanotechnology. 

We bring together expertise in transfection, bioprocessing and drug formulation to develop reagent tools that offer enormous potential for advances in drug efficiency and targeted delivery.

Using nanoparticle-forming technology, our Tecrea scientists have developed Nanocin – a range of transfection, small molecule, protein and peptide delivery reagents that are able to facilitate unsurpassed levels of accuracy, speed and yield.

Relying on a dynamic system that rapidly self-assembles molecules and then “packages” them into nanoparticles, our platform significantly enhances cellular delivery into both mammalian and bacterial cells.

All of this is achieved whilst maintaining >99% cell viability; a unique feature of our nanotechnology that distinguishes Nanocin from other reagent tools.

As our nanotechnology is uniquely translatable from the lab to the clinic, this allows you to deliver even more effective research and potential future treatments using the same platform throughout your drug development process.

What does that mean in practice? It means that you, our partners, and the wider biomedical research community have access to novel delivery reagents that offer unparalleled opportunities to advance drug development, bioprocessing and research, without compromising on experiment integrity.

At Tecrea, we think small so you can work big.

We specialize in the development and supply of recombinant antigens, antibodies, and advanced immunoassay solutions, supporting biomarker discovery, translational research, in vitro diagnostic (IVD) development, and immunogenicity assessment. Our proprietary Epitogen Scaffold Technology enables the efficient expression and presentation of complex linear and conformational epitopes, improving assay performance, consistency, and scalability.

By integrating our AI epitope application into protein engineering, we help partners overcome long-standing challenges in antigen production for autoimmune, infectious, and chronic diseases, as well as in vaccine design and evaluation.

Name: Iceni Glycoscience (formerly Iceni Diagnostics)
Description:
Iceni Glycoscience is an innovative platform company with world-class expertise in glycoscience (carbohydrate chemistry and biology), exploiting the use of glycans (complex sugars) in the areas of mutation-proof diagnostics and therapeutics.

Every type of cell in our body has a unique sugar coating. Whenever anything such as bacteria or virus interacts with the body it needs to interact with this ‘sugar code.’ At Iceni Glycoscience we are developing ways to unlock this complex code to offer new ways to diagnose and treat disease.

With mounting concerns about coronavirus mutations and rising incidents of influenza (human, equine and avian), the need for new and improved diagnostics and therapeutic modalities to address infectious disease has never been greater. These need to be capable of producing earlier, faster, more accurate results - something which glycoscience methodologies offer by working uniquely at the initial binding stage of a virus. They have the potential to pick up on new variants or mutations far quicker than tests which typically work by detecting viral nucleic acids or proteins, both of which require prior knowledge about the virus structure.

Here at Iceni Glycoscience (formerly Iceni Diagnostics) we have been pioneering the use of glycoscience for diagnostic and therapeutic benefit since 2014, exploiting the natural biological function of glycans (complex sugars) as an alternative to protein or nucleic acid targets.

In addition to our portfolio of in-house programmes, we provide bespoke solutions in glycoscience R&D, nanoparticle technology and bioconjugation chemistry.  We are open to engagement with the biotech and pharma sectors, and Government-sponsored research organisations globally, to provide our unique expertise on a contract service basis.

#glycoscience #glycobiology #glycotime

Name: Biotica

Name: Gramics Bio
Description:
We're building the non-viral delivery platform to unlock durable, cell-type-specific DNA therapeutics that can be re-dosed. 

Our approach addresses a major limitation in current genetic medicine: the inability of lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) to deliver DNA to the nucleus, which is essential for effective and sustained gene expression without the use of viruses. 

Our platform integrates synthetic biology, AI/ML, and high-throughput screening to build effective DNA payloads. By enabling LNPs to deliver therapeutic genes with cell-type specificity and durable expression, we combine the safety and manufacturability of LNPs with the long-lasting treatment effects of viral gene therapy. 

We are starting with a gene therapy for cystic fibrosis but our platform has broad applicability for DNA-based therapeutics in tissues and organs beyond the lung. 

Founded by a scientist and a CF patient advocate, we're backed by Deep Science Ventures and the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation.

Name: Creation Engineering Bioreactors
Description:
Bioprinting has solved how to bioprint a 3D construct. The harder problem is what comes next: keeping that construct alive, fed and oxygenated until it becomes functional tissue. Beyond roughly 100–200 μm, oxygen and nutrients can no longer diffuse far enough to keep cells alive so every thick construct starves at its core unless media is actively perfused through it. That maturation step is where tissue engineering stalls, and it's the only thing we work on.

Our VascuFlow range is a family of benchtop perfusion bioreactors Core, One, X and GMP that flow oxygenated media through a 3D construct in a closed, sterile loop, under precise, continuously monitored control of dissolved oxygen, pH, temperature and flow. Flow paths are designed and validated with CFD and AI-assisted simulation to keep shear low and perfusion uniform, so cells survive and develop instead of dying or mis-differentiating.

We design hardware that is affordable, instrumented and incubator-ready at a fraction of the cost and footprint of legacy systems for the academic and industry labs doing the science. AI is our engineering accelerator, not our product: the deliverable is validated hardware and reproducible biology.

Applications include cartilage and bone, vascular and cardiac constructs, perfused tissue models for drug discovery, and a path toward organ-on-chip systems.

Name: xRapid Group
Description:
Environmental Services - Biotechnologie

Founded in 2015 by Jean Viry-Babel and Prof. David Mendels, xRapid Group was created with the hope of applying the evolving technologies of artificial intelligence (AI) and computer vision to previously unexplored fields with the hopes of improving the lives of people the world over. The first application of Prof. Mendels knowledge was to tackle the issue of diagnosing malaria in remote areas where the demand for skilled analysts exceeded the supply of resources, both human and monetary. It was during the research and development of this application that Dr. Charlyn Belluzzo came on to supervise the medical aspects of the testing. After acquiring approval through the World Health Organization we have been able to help citizens in Benin, Indonesia, Malawi, Papua, and Uganda by offering this testing at little to no cost through xRapid Foundation. We are continuing to work with governments around the world to develop AI-driven medical tests that can help those that would otherwise be overlooked or forgotten.

In the latter part of 2016, William Young came into contact with xRapid Group and proposed a way to fund our philanthropic research through commercial application of our technology in the area of environmental testing. This lead to the founding of xRapid Environment and the development of xR Fiber and the xR Testing Platform. This also began our work, in earnest, in the specialty of AI known as deep learning. With this technology we have been able to effectively automate the analysis of air fiber samples taken for testing of asbestos fibers in indoor environments and outdoor work sites. We have now also begun development of a similar analysis for mold spores in air and plan to continue in several other environmental areas. Ultimately, our resolve to improve people’s lives, by applying emerging technologies to areas others have yet to, has not wavered and we hope to touch as many lives as possible in the years to come.

Name: ErebaGen
Description:
ErabeGen’s vision is to become a leader in the creation of novel solutions to intractable chemistry problems providing cheaper, sustainable bio-based solutions to manufacture

Many small molecule chemicals are made using synthetic chemistry involving polluting solvents and waste products, high energy needs and in some cases highly hazardous processes. Enzymes or biocatalysts from natural sources can replace synthetic chemistry to overcome these problems and bacteria have been the largest source.

We are creating a new generation of cost-effective, sustainable bio-based manufacturing processes by replacing synthetic chemistry with biocatalysis. Our innovative approach addresses intractable chemistry using technologies that are fast and scalable for greener manufacturing processes incorporating single or multiple biocatalytic steps. While competitors seek biocatalyst diversity between many different species of microorganism, we uniquely target the induced metabolism of each bacterial strain, finding biocatalysts not usually expressed under lab conditions.

Our preclinical contract research services group advance drug development programs for oncology, inflammatory, dermatology, auto-immune and GI disease indications. We offer an impressive range of preclinical models in these therapeutic areas.  We also provide information relating to toxicity assessments and are experts in GI tox.  We also offer a broad range of cell based assays including novel stem cell assays.
Our biomarker services division offers GCLP compliant genetic testing, histology, FACS analysis and protein biomarker detection. 
Epistem’s genetics group offer gene expression and DNA genotyping sample analysis by NGS, microarray and qPCR.  We specialise in working with small starting materials (down to a single cell input) applying our proprietary low input techniques and products to support drug development programs.  We are specialists in fractionating cell populations and conducting genetic analysis.  We have pioneered techniques using plucked scalp hair and laser capture microdissected material to provide gene expression biomarker information to drug development programs.  
Epistem is committed to provide reliable and innovative services to support all phases of drug development from to preclinical projects to clinical trials.
Website: www.epsitem.co.uk

Name: Celentyx Ltd
Description:
Celentyx Ltd is a ‘boutique’ CRO providing bespoke drug discovery services focused on human immunology across a broad range of therapeutic areas including autoimmunity, inflammation, immuno-oncology, fibrosis and neuroinflammation.
 
Celentyx has a highly experienced scientific team that develops and provides assays using human primary cells at all stages of the drug discovery pipeline. Situated in close proximity to major hospitals and blood services (with established partnerships), assays can be performed at scale using blood and tissue from healthy volunteers and patients with defined disease including deep access to their clinical records.
 
Celentyx has well-established assay platforms in multi-colour flow-cytometry, Cytof, high-content imaging, multiplex supernatant analysis (Luminex), super-resolution microscopy as well as proteomic and molecular biology capability, enabling high-resolution analysis of the human immune system for target discovery, screening, candidate selection, mechanism of action, and biomarker studies.
 
Celentyx is based in the UK (Oxford and Birmingham) and in addition to internationally recognised scientists within the company, benefits from the world-leading expertise of neighbouring translational medicine departments at the Universities of Oxford and Birmingham.

Name: Cansford Labs
Description:
At Cansford Laboratories, we specialise in fast, accurate drug and alcohol testing, delivering reliable results with UK’s fastest turnaround times.

We’ve been at the forefront of hair testing in the UK for over 30 years. Our founders helped pioneer the process, and our team has spent every year since improving the science and widening access to dependable, high-quality testing. Today, we offer a growing range of services including segmented hair analysis, nail testing, PEth and DNA testing, with an ever-expanding list of substances.

We don't just give a yes or no answer. Every result we produce is quantifiable and transparent. A Certificate of Analysis comes as standard with each test, and when more detail is needed, our scientists can provide clear, expert reports that include formal declarations, sample detail and their qualifications. All of this is delivered within three working days of receiving the sample.

Our nationwide network of over 50 trained collectors can reach any location in the UK within 48 hours, making it easy to get testing started quickly, wherever you are.

We’re proud to work with anyone who needs accurate, science-backed results they can trust. Whether you're supporting a family, managing risk, or making decisions that rely on clear evidence, we’re here to help with a knowledgeable, approachable team that’s with you at every step.

Name: twig
Description:
twig is a full-stack AI bioengineering company building the technology layers to design, engineer, and scale microbial production of high-performance, sustainable molecules for personal care and cosmetics, speciality industrial chemicals and beyond.

A key differentiator is our end-to-end data engine - bio:drive. We’ve built our lab, assay, and fermentation workflows specifically to generate high-quality, structured data for AI, capturing genotype–phenotype relationships, pathway performance, and bioprocess conditions. This gives us a compounding advantage in training predictive models on real, high-signal data.

At the core of the bio:drive platform:

1. CANOPY – our foundation model for engineering biology, guiding target selection, pathway design, and strain optimisation.
2. Hazel – a biomanufacturing specific multi-agent system that researches, evaluates and validates molecule/ingredient candidates, presenting risks and potential mitigations across key stages from discovery through to TEA and scale-up risk.  Access it here: https://askhazel.bio
3. Enzyme Generation – combining state-of-the-art protein language models with biophysical simulation to design and evaluate enzymes for novel and manufacturing-optimised biochemistry.

Combined with our high-throughput, low-cost lab processes, we routinely build and test a design space of millions of unique genotypes, generating deep datasets that improve our predictive power. We are at a stage where models guide experiments and experiments continuously improve the models—across both strain engineering and bioprocess development (e.g. media optimisation, fermentation conditions).

We span the full stack from enzyme → pathway → strain → process, and focus on bringing sustainable, high-performance molecules to market that can compete with petrochemicals on cost, performance and impact.

Name: adthera bio
Description:
We are a highly experienced digital first company focused exclusively on cell and gene therapy process development and manufacturing. 

We are the partner of choice in high quality GxP development and manufacturing in Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products.

We take your cell therapy ideas and make them into workable medical interventions for patients, all in a regulatory compliant and quality managed system, to get it right first time. Based on brilliant ideas and curious capable minds, we partner with biotechs and academic centres to bring novel ATMP therapies to market and thus to patients who urgently need them. We have highly personalised approaches from the patient to the client to the treatment outcome.

Name: Colibri Cytometry
Description:
Let your data take flight with Colibri Cytometry!

Colibri Cytometry provides technical tips and suggestions to improve your flow cytometry.

We also offer consulting services:
-Panel design and optimization
-Sample processing through ultra-high parameter flow panels
-High parameter data analysis
-Product testing and consultation

Name: Aspire Biosciences
Description:
ASPIRE BIOSCIENCES aims to find new treatments for unaddressed and rare diseases, by creating and nurturing working partnerships between rare disease patient organisations and drug development companies. Based on several success stories, we’ve designed the Systematic Serendipity methodology, which significantly shifts the cost-benefit function of rare disease treatments, facilitating economically viable development. Systematic Serendipity harnesses both human and machine intelligence to identify drug development opportunities, and promotes them through partnering patient groups with company assets. We implement it through specialized partnering events, and a searchable database enabling both human searchers and algorithms to match company assets with target diseases.

Get in touch with us to discuss our upcoming events, as well as the opportunity to showcase relevant assets on our database.

Name: MERXIN Ltd
Description:
We Make Inhalers: We specialise in designing and supplying inhaler devices including dry powder and soft mist inhalers. Our expertise spans various therapeutic categories from biologics and small molecules to generic and novel therapies. We create, develop and supply inhaler devices for evaluation through to commercial supply.

We Will Launch You: Merxin Ltd’s inhalers save customers time and money to develop, file and market inhaled dosage forms. Our DNA is in the pharma industry. Merxin Ltd is committed to delivering quality, reliability, and efficacy. Our reputation is built on excellence. 

Make It Better: Merxin Ltd has been assessed and certified as meeting the requirements of ISO 13485:2016 for the Design, Development, and Supply of inhalers. Established in Kings Lynn UK, in 2015, we have expanded our manufacturing capacity globally and serve international clients. 

Our goal is to improve your molecules efficacy and improve patient outcomes worldwide.

Name: SOLASTA Bio
Description: SOLASTA Bio is an ambitious bioinsecticides start up with a unique proposition: nature-inspired small molecule insect control products for the global agricultural market. We are a small but passionate and world-leading team - join us!

Name: Mursla Bio
Description:
Mursla Bio is a UK- and Boston–based precision medicine and diagnostics company spun out of the University of Cambridge. The company has developed a clinically validated, AI-enabled platform that analyzes tissue-specific extracellular vesicles (TS-EVs) from blood to deliver tissue-resolved, multiomic insights not accessible through standard liquid biopsy approaches. 

Mursla’s initial focus is liver disease, where its lead program, EvoLiverTM, is the only FDA Breakthrough-designated blood test for liver cancer surveillance for 7 years. EvoLiver leverages a capital-efficient, hepatology-led pathway to enable guideline-driven adoption and reimbursement. 

Beyond liver cancer surveillance, Mursla is advancing precision medicine partnerships in metabolic liver disease (MASH), anchored by a landmark big pharma collaboration, and selectively expanding its platform to additional organs.

Name: AB Biotek
Description:
AB Biotek is a leading global technology-driven business specialising in yeast and fermentation solutions for the food, nutrition, health, alcohol beverage, and bio-ethanol industries. We have a long history of pioneering expertise in advanced micro-organism fermentation, actively developing both proprietary technology and strategically partnering with external institutions to create value-added products. Having a deep understanding of fermentation processes and technology applications within the industries we serve, AB Biotek has a long heritage of being a trusted partner to customers.

As a global business we have commercial, research, development and applications teams in multiple locations. In addition, as AB Biotek is a business division of AB Mauri and part of Associated British Foods (ABF) we benefit from wider access to the resources and infrastructure of a multi-billion global network of technology businesses.

For more information, please visit www.abbiotek.com.

Name: Mary Lyon Centre at MRC Harwell
Description:
At the Mary Lyon Centre at MRC Harwell, we are working to improve our understanding of human disease through the study of mouse models and providing mouse genetics services to scientists around the world. These services cover all aspects of preclinical disease modelling in mice, including mouse model generation, a wide array of phenotyping tests, and archiving and distribution services.

We adhere to the highest welfare standards and are proactively committed to implementing the 3Rs for the benefit of mouse health and welfare, while also improving the quality of the scientific data generated.

MRC Harwell is also home to the Advance training centre, which delivers our world-class practical and theoretical training courses and has labs and training rooms available to hire.

Name: DJS Antibodies
Description: At DJS we are developing novel therapeutics to treat chronic inflammatory diseases. We do this through the discovery and development of novel therapeutic monoclonal antibodies against GPCRs. Our breakthrough technology enables us to produce first-in-class antibody therapeutics to previously intractable disease targets.

Name: Clasado
Description:
A leader in next-generation prebiotics, Clasado Biosciences is your partner of choice for scientifically supported gut health product development.

Established in Reading, United Kingdom in 2004 and celebrating two decades of scientifically backed prebiotic expertise, Clasado is the company behind multi award-winning ingredient, Bimuno GOS, a prebiotic galactooligosaccharide trusted by health and nutrition brands worldwide. The ingredient's capabilities for improving health and well-being are supported by more than 135 publications and over 25 clinical studies, giving it the most comprehensive research portfolio of any commercially available GOS. These publications demonstrate how it can support health in as fast as 7 days from a low dose, catering to health areas such as gastrointestinal, immune and cognitive health. Bimuno's high stability makes it easy to work with across various applications from supplements and medical nutrition to functional food and beverages. 

Bimuno GOS offers true scientific value to brands and products world wide.

Name: Cellular Highways
Description:
Cellular Highways manufactures an automated high-throughput cell sorting instrument, the Highway1, for Cell and Gene Therapy, research, process development, and manufacturing. 

The Highway1 reduces the cost and complexity of cell sorting and achieves far higher throughput than existing platforms, making cell sorting accessible to every laboratory and manufacturing workflows.

Gentler Cell Sorting. Healthier Cells.

Name: Biochrom Ltd.
Description:
Biochrom Ltd is a leading manufacturer of scientific instruments with over 40 years experience. The Biochrom Group consists of five well known instrument brands covering UV/Vis spectroscopy, microplate instrumentation and amino acid analysis. Our products are trusted by hospitals and laboratories worldwide and we are a valued OEM partner of many of the world’s finest scientific instrumentation companies.
 
Although the name Biochrom may not be familiar, our instrument brands will be. The Biochrom spectroscopy range includes the Novaspec, Ultrospec, and GeneQuant, plus the Biochrom Libra and and Biochrom WPA brands. 

Biochrom WPA is known for its great value spectrophotometers and colorimeters with a tiny footprint combined with the technical performance and analytical power of much larger (and more expensive) instruments. The Biochrom Libra range meets the full range of spectroscopy requirements for industrial, analytical and Life Science applications, from simple hand held colorimeters to high performance double beam spectrophotometers.

Biochrom manufactures two major brand names in the microplate instrumentation market – Biochrom Asys and Biochrom Anthos. Originating in Austria, these are regarded worldwide as premier ranges of high performance microplate readers and washers. All products offer laboratories excellent performance at a sensible price.

The Biochrom 30+ is recognized as the gold standard dedicated amino acid analyzer worldwide. It allows users to accurately detect and quantify amino acids and their derivatives in complex samples.  Applications are available both for clinical analysis and screening of metabolic disorders, for drug synthesis, infusion fluids and for industrial applications in food, beverage and feedstuffs. 

All our instruments are available through a growing global network of independent distributors, backed by our commitment to customer support. Biochrom is a Harvard Bioscience Company.

Name: Sun Bear Biofuture
Description:
We believe that everyone should be able to make easy choices they know are sustainable and healthy.

We are reimagining farming by blending the natural process of fermentation with modern science and technology, in order to make everyday essentials.

We just happen to make great alternatives to tropical oils, like cocoa butter.

Name: Autolomous
Description:
Autolomous is a company founded by Cell and Gene Therapy (CGT)- and software development experts, who have combined their skills to deliver elegant, seamless and agile solutions to the CGT sector. Autolomous will deliver the digital solutions necessary for CGT to achieve scalability, allowing more patients to benefit from these life changing therapies. The company is creating a portfolio of software solutions (AutoloMATE-solution platform), from electronic Batch Manufacturing Records (eBMR) to enabling the scheduling of the patient blood collections at hospital; the transport of those cells to the manufacturing facilities; enhancing traceability throughout the manufacturing process; supporting compliance with current and future regulatory requirements; expediting the drug product release; and the scheduled delivery of the patient-specific medicine to the hospital. Our software will enable increased automation of these processes, reducing the risk of errors and ensuring that the correct product is returned to the right patient. AutoloMATE has been architected with agility, flexibility and adaptability in mind both for our customers for customization but also for our partners to integrate with our platform to create an end-to-end digital ecosystem.

We’re looking for new team members. Are you a forward-thinking-digitally-minded individual? Do you want to be part of a meaningful and value-orientated company? Get in touch!

Name: InBio
Description:
Whether you conduct primary research on allergens, develop
diagnostic systems, or create products to alleviate environmental
and food allergies, you need expertise in action. And that’s exactly
what InBio delivers, across everything from highly purified allergens
and advanced test kits, to environmental and food allergen testing,
to contract research for specialized needs.
• Broad product catalog
• Deep scientific background
• Ongoing commitment to R&D
• Well-documented subject-matter expertise
• Direct contact with our scientific team
• Flexible, collaborative relationships

Name: Astellas Engineered Small Molecules U.K. Ltd.
Description: Astellas Engineered Small Molecules U.K. Ltd. (formerly Nanna Therapeutics Ltd) is part of Astellas. Follow Astellas Pharma as we continue advancing small molecule focused therapeutics.  This page is no longer active or monitored.

Name: TRUPCR Europe
Description: With an experienced team and innovative products, TRUPCR Europe manufactures and supplies its range of TRUPCR high quality CE-IVD molecular diagnostic products throughout the world. Specialising in oncology, infectious disease and coagulation, our innovative products offer superior performance, accuracy and precision.

Name: Vicebio
Description:
Vicebio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing transformative multi-pathogen vaccines for respiratory viral infections.
At the core of our work is Vicebio’s groundbreaking Molecular Clamp Technology, which locks viral proteins in their optimal conformation. This innovation enables our vaccines to deliver a unique combination of broad protection, ready-to-use administration, and convenient manufacturing.
Our lead program is a best-in-class multivalent vaccine targeting five respiratory diseases, positioning Vicebio as a leader in multipathogen respiratory vaccines.

Name: Carrick Therapeutics
Description:
Carrick Therapeutics is pioneering a portfolio of unique, first in class, cancer treatments that target driver mechanisms of the most aggressive forms of cancer, and which will be tailored to an individual patient’s tumour.
Targeting the molecular pathways that drive the most aggressive and resistant forms of cancer will transform the way that cancer is treated and have a major impact on the lives of cancer patients. By linking a network of clinicians and scientists in internationally leading research institutes and hospitals, Carrick will streamline the introduction of these ground-breaking cancer therapies into the clinic, thus serving cancer patients around the world.

Name: OpenCell
Description:
With so much potential for biotech to make the world a better place to live, we knew we needed to make the lab a better place to work.

We’re a team of scientists and designers who have meticulously studied the in-lab experience, getting a detailed understanding of workflows and identifying common pain points that routinely cost scientists time and money. 

Our BioHotel labs are designed with biotech startups in mind:
- Short term, flexible leases 
- Central London locations in key life sciences clusters 
- BSL2 lab spaces that can be tailored to your workflow 
- Specialist services including cryogenic freezer storage, glassware washing and sterilisation and a lab coat laundry
- Access to bookable specialist labs and equipment
- All-inclusive clinical, chemical and general waste services 
- Discounts and free delivery from our store

Name: Bastion Therapeutics
Description:
Bastion Therapeutics was a biotech co-founded by Nia Emami. 

Our mission was to develop novel Treg cell therapies for inflammatory disorders with high unmet need.

We used our proprietary GRITTM platform to engineer Tregs that modulate the immune system and overcome key limitations of earlier approaches.

Our goal was to create therapies that are safe, durable, and truly effective for patients.

Bastion Therapeutics concluded operations in December 2024.

Name: Isogen Life Science
Description:
Already more than 30 years on the market, Isogen Life Science provides a wide range of instruments, reagents and consumables in the areas of cell biology, molecular biology and biochemistry. Our products are used by biotechnology companies and leading research institutes. 

Our headquarter is in De Meern, the Netherlands with sales operatives in Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, Spain, Portugal and the UK. 

We have our own service organization qualified to also perform IQ/OQ/PQ.

We always look for new products that innovate life science research and diagnostics.

Interested to see what we can offer you to bring your research to the next level? Please contact get in contact with our experts via info@isogen-lifescience.com or call +31 30 6880771

Name: NostraPharma
Description:
We are passionate about our work, we love to learn, and make an impact. 

Since 2008, NostraPharma has combined operational proficiency, pharmacovigilance, quality and audit expertise with AI governance, helping pharma and biotech companies safeguard patients, develop regulatory compliance agility while embracing technology and innovation with the confidence. 

We have a strong collaboration and partnerships within the industry, academia and many associations. With a worldwide network and offices in the UK, Bosnia, and Czech Republic, our clients are supported across various territories and regulatory frameworks.

As an ISO 9001:2015 certified company, NostraPharma's commitment to maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance helps our clients worldwide in confidently achieving their strategic objectives.

Name: CopptechTM Antimicrobial Technology
Description:
At Copptech, our technology is more than just an ingredient. We work directly with our partners to develop solutions that take their production innovation ideas to the next level across a wide range of industries around the world.

Available in a variety of materials, including masterbatch, powder, liquid, yarn, and thread, our antimicrobial technology can be flexibly integrated into existing manufacturing processes. 

Our successful product partner collaborations make a difference in every day lives from socks and insoles that fight embarassing odors to food packaging that helps keep food fresher, longer and construction materials that fight mold, mildew and even termites.

We are committed to continuously improving lives by providing ingredient technology  that withstands the test of time.

Name: Trogenix
Description: Trogenix develops precision genetic medicines using its Odysseus platform, which harnesses Synthetic Super-Enhancers (SSEs) to distinguish cancer cell states from healthy ones and drive selective payload delivery. Its methodology combines controlled cell killing, immune modulation, and long-term protection against recurrence. The company pursues therapeutic programmes in aggressive solid tumours, notably glioblastoma, and explores expansion into colorectal liver metastases, hepatocellular carcinoma, and lung cancer. Trogenix also partners with manufacturing and development specialists (e.g. Viralgen) to accelerate production of its gene therapy assets.

Name: Biogelx
Description:
Biogelx is helping people work in translational science, drug discovery and tissue engineering by 'making in vitro cell cultures more in vivo'. We do this through manufacturing and supplying 3D cell cultures that can be tuned to specific tissues and synthetic bio-inks that are reproducible, scalable, easy to handle and suitable for clinical decision making.

Our portfolio of biomaterials is comprised of synthetic peptide hydrogels that act as extracellular-matrix environments to support cell growth. In addition, the chemical and physical properties of our biomaterials can be precisely tuned to replicate the characteristics of specific tissues so that the cells experience and engage with a realistic 3D environment. 

If you have interests in Biogelx 3D cell culture systems we would be delighted to talk to you, there is no cost to exploring potential opportunities. 

Tel: +44 (0) 1698 534655
Email: info@biogelx.com
www.biogelx.com

Name: CroBio
Description:
CroBio is a soil regeneration company using biotechnology to prevent crop loss from drought conditions. Our living soil amendment forms a symbiotic relationship with roots and produces a sponge-like environment to better hold water and nutrients for crops.

We’re on a mission to improve the resilience of crops and farmers by transforming soil. We believe the future of farming is made possible through biological aid, empowering farmers to withstand drought and keep growing, year after year.

Name: YouSeq
Description: YouSeq specialise in the design, development and manufacture of Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) and qPCR kits, panels and reagents.  We are experts at creating simple to use, complete kits with all the components necessary for fast and accurate detection on any platform. Let us help you to detect more.

Name: Alcyomics
Description:
Alcyomics is a specialist clinical research organization (CRO) supporting the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and cosmetics industries. We offer full assay services and  technical consultancy in immuno-toxicology.  This is underpinned by our patented human in vitro skin assay platform, Skimune, which provides highly sensitive detection of adverse immune reactions for pre-clinical testing of small and large molecule drugs, monoclonal antibodies, cellular therapies, cosmetic compounds etc. plus many more.

Further to our immunotoxicity platforms we also specialise in 3D assay design, optimisation and validation. We have a number of 3D assays in-house such as;

- Autologous skin model, Skimune 3D, for high-throughput immunotoxicity testing. 

- 3D innervated skin model is based in a 96-well scaffold system and has been specifically validated to detect peripheral toxicity against monoclonal antibodies and chemical insults. 

- Bioprinted osteo-chondral model incorporates the complex environment present in osteoarthritis. 

- Autologous atopic dermatitis models incorporating immune cellular function to assess compound function, efficacy and toxicity. 

From our state of the art facilities based within the custom built Biosphere labs in Newcastle-upon-Tyne, UK, we provide assured, experienced, professional assay support and consultancy to local, national, and international clients.

Our Mission at Alcyomics is to provide robust in vitro human assays to the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, chemical and cosmetic industries that enable early detection of adverse immune reactions, reducing risk and cost in the development of drugs and compounds.

www.alcyomics.com
Location: Newcastle upon Tyne, England, United Kingdom

Name: NeoPhore Ltd
Description:
Broadening cancer patient access to powerful disease-transforming immunotherapy. 

Our therapeutic approach transiently blocks DNA Mismatch Repair (MMR) to mimic the known robust and durable clinical responses to immunotherapy of patients with genetically MMR-deficient tumours.

Our medicine will bring the proven therapeutic benefits of cancer immunotherapy to substantially more cancer patients.

Name: Bitesize Bio
Description:
Bitesize Bio helps bioscience researchers to grow by collating personal experience, advice, practical tools, and wisdom from experienced mentors. That’s hundreds of the world’s brightest brains helping you get the most out of your research career. 

Join the Bitesize Bio community and become a wiser, more successful, and happier researcher.

https://bit.ly/Join-this-community

Name: Labtron Equipment ltd
Description:
Labtron Equipment Ltd is a UK based Laboratory Equipment company. We provide lab equipment with a large variety of high quality products including Freezers, Refrigerators, Freeze Dryers, Ice Maker and Test Chamber

We are committed to compliance with international standards for lab instruments performance and safety.

The instruments manufactured and supplied by us for medical lab are tested by our experts and serves the purpose of providing a better user experience with our quality of sales and service

Name: OracleBio
Description:
OracleBio is a global leader in quantitative digital pathology, providing image analysis services to Pharma and Biotech clients worldwide. Leveraging multiple software platforms, the company delivers robust data packages within a quality management framework to support clinical trials and translational research. 

As image analysis experts, OracleBio specialises in cellular phenotyping of multiplex stained tissue and has built a strong reputation as the go-to company for complex image analysis.

Name: Biomap Ltd
Description:
Biomap Ltd is a leading provider of temperature monitoring solutions, calibration, packaging qualification and shipping studies, as well as products to the Life Sciences industry.

We operate in a heavily regulated environment working with a wide range of companies from Pharmaceutical Manufacturing & Distribution, Wholesalers, Clinical Trials Supplies, Blood Storage and various Hospital & Laboratory environments. 

Biomap Ltd supports its clients specifically around temperature compliance, generally within cGDP & cGMP regulated environments.

Name: Mootral
Description:
Mootral is a British biotech company operating at the intersection of two existential crises of our time - climate change and antimicrobial resistance.

Our natural solutions are enabling a shift to new standards in agriculture by allowing farmers and processors to significantly reduce their methane footprint and improve animal health, thereby future-proofing our global food ecosystem.

mootral.com

Name: Yellowstone Biosciences
Description:
Yellowstone aims to unlock a new class of therapeutically targetable frequently expressed antigens with potential to significantly transform patient lives.

Spun out of the University of Oxford, Yellowstone is built around the pioneering research of Professor Paresh Vyas, a world-renowned scientific academic, key opinion leader and practising clinician with a specialist focus on acute myeloid leukaemia (AML).

The Company is headquartered in Oxford, UK, with backing from a leading FTSE 250 healthcare company, Syncona.

Name: Esox Biologics
Description:
At Esox Biologics, we harness the power of metagenomics to give aquaculture farms a complete picture of the microbial world living alongside their livestock.

With just one sample, we detect every pathogen and beneficial microbe with strain level identification, providing comprehensive insights into the microbes that influences livestock health, water quality, and disease risk.

Name: Neobe Therapeutics
Description:
At Neobe Therapeutics we are engineering tumour-colonizing bacteria that will disrupt tumour micro environment barriers and enable immunotherapies in patients with immune-excluded tumours. 

Only around 20% of patients with solid tumors are estimated to currently benefit from immunotherapies. Multiple factors contribute to this low level of efficacy. Chief among them is the existence of an immunosuppressive microenvironment that leads to the generation of immune "cold" tumours.

At Neobe we are harnessing the synthetic biology toolkit to engineer tumour-colonizing bacteria that locally disrupt this microenvironment. By acting locally within the tumor, these products avoid systemic toxicities while increasing drug efficacy. Disrupting these barriers and increasing immune cell infiltration in "cold" tumours will enable the success of immunotherapies in current non-responders.

Name: Oliyai Consulting
Description:
Oliyai Consulting Corporation (OCC) is a premier consulting firm serving the pharmaceutical and biotech industries, distinguished by the real-world expertise of its subject matter experts. 

We partner with 140+ clients from global pharma and biotech leaders to emerging startups to accelerate drug development from lead optimization through commercialization, with a core focus on Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC). 

Our 150+ seasoned professionals bring extensive and integrated experience in drug development, manufacturing, and commercialization, supported by strong connections to the global CRO/CDMO network. We deliver cost-effective, tailored solutions to complex strategic, scientific, technical, and operational challenges. 

Our expertise spans small molecules, peptides, biologics, ADCs, oligonucleotides (siRNA, mRNA, ASOs), cell therapies, and drug–device combination products. We support multiple delivery routes, including oral, injectable (IV, IM, SC, LAI), Intracerebroventricular (ICV), intravitreal, inhalation, nasal, ophthalmic, intrathecal, and pediatric formulations. We provide phase-appropriate regulatory, quality, and compliance support and are actively involved in numerous IND, IMPD, NDA, MAA, and BLA submissions. Beyond CMC, we offer expertise in preclinical development, patent litigation support, and organizational development. 

Founded by Dr. Reza Oliyai, a pharmaceutical leader with over 30 years of industry experience, OCC is built on a legacy of innovation and operational excellence. As Senior Vice President at Gilead Sciences, Dr. Oliyai led the development of more than 300 drug candidates and the commercialization of over 25 products — experience that continues to guide OCC’s mission to help clients navigate complexity and achieve success. 

To learn more please contact Reza Oliyai at reza.o@oliyaiconsulting.com.

Name: FOLIUM Science
Description:
FOLIUM Science leads the way in bioscience technology for the healthy biotic era. With game-changing, patented science that harnesses naturally occurring mechanisms to selectively remove unwanted pathogenic and spoilage bacteria, FOLIUM Science is working to deliver solutions for increased productivity at all points in the food and agriculture value chain

Application in animal rearing
High bacterial burdens create waste, provide a human zoonotic risk, or inhibit growth and consequentially the productive rearing of animals. FOLIUM’s Guided BioticsTM act as a preventative measure when added to animal feed; selectively reducing the bacterial burden of the animal. Our Guided BioticsTM are complementary to other feed additives such as enzymes and probiotics, to provide a total effective feed supplement and effective bacterial manager in healthy animal rearing.  FOLIUM has solutions for all Enterobacteriaceae as well as other specific bacteria

Application in plant lifecycle
Guided BioticsTM can also be used in plants; selectively removing plant pathogens that can create significant waste in world crops.  FOLIUM has solutions for over 70% of all bacteria blight, wilt or rot issues

Application to support soil condition
Our technology will help condition soil with inoculators by maintaining the right bacterial colonies and condition of the soil, thus maintaining the optimal productive potential for a specific plant requirement. By controlling the bacterial population, FOLIUM's technology base will support the bacterial Biome in the soil to aid plant growth throughout its life cycle of germination, growth, reproduction, pollination, budding, flowering or fruiting.

Name: Ternary Therapeutics
Description: TernaryTx, a pioneering biotech startup, with a revolutionary AI-driven platform for designing molecular glue therapeutics, opening new frontiers in drug discovery for previously "undruggable" targets.

Name: Dark Blue Therapeutics
Description:
Pioneering the next generation of precision medicines to deliver a portfolio of transformative cancer therapies.

Dark Blue Therapeutics is an innovative drug discovery biotechnology company based in Oxford, UK. We have assembled a highly experienced team, whose expertise spans the breadth of drug development from discovery to approval. This expertise has been gained over many years in the industry and draws from biotech, large pharmaceutical companies and investment management. 

Dark Blue leverages ground-breaking cancer biology insights, from Oxford University, to discover and develop innovative precision medicines that exploit novel vulnerabilities and dependencies.  With this deep, proprietary understanding of target biology we match our precision medicines to molecularly defined patient populations to develop transformative, durable drugs that address critical unmet patient needs, delivering medicines that transform the outcomes for cancer patients. We work across a variety of biological mechanisms to identify and pursue only cancer targets that have the highest transformative potential.

Name: Vivan Therapeutics
Description: Personalised cancer therapeutics platform pioneered at Mount Sinai Medical Center

Name: Thistle Scientific
Description:
Science is never done. 
 
It’s full speed to a finish line we’ll never reach. Yet every generation edges us closer.

For 30 years at Thistle, we’ve put leading innovation in the hands of scientists, so they can test limits, chase answers and leave the world in a better place for people we’ll never meet. One hypothesis at a time.

How?

We manufacture. We’re always searching for the next solution to blockers in science. Then we bring them to life. We distribute. With our global network of scientific suppliers, we put ever-evolving laboratory products in your hands. We innovate. Our team has one brief: equip researchers to be relentless. We customise. Name: Re-Vana Therapeutics
Description:
Intravitreal anti-VEGF therapy has revolutionized the management of major retinal diseases, with revenues projected to reach $19 billion by 2029. Yet, a significant unmet need remains: patients must endure frequent in-office injections and monitoring, while real-world outcomes continue to fall short of clinical trial results.

A key driver of this treatment burden is the rate of drug clearance. Current practice addresses this by injecting large amounts of drug, well above the clinically relevant dose, to extend the treatment window to roughly 3–4 months for a subset of patients.

Re-Vana takes a fundamentally different approach. Instead of delivering high excess doses, our technologies enable sustained, controlled release of smaller amounts of drug, maintaining therapeutic concentrations for 6–12 months without the peaks, troughs, and treatment gaps that compromise patient outcomes. By reducing injections to twice yearly-or potentially once yearly, without surgery, we aim to keep patients consistently within the therapeutic window. Our approach has the potential to improve real-world outcomes while dramatically reducing treatment burden.

The treatment burden and drug clearance challenge affects all retinal therapies, representing an enormous opportunity for Re-Vana. Our proprietary photo crosslinked biodegradable hydrogel technologies. EyeLief and OcuLief are designed to avoid inflammation and to protect biologics from aggregation and degradation.  Re-Vana’s technologies are therapeutic-modality agnostic (including Biologics, Peptide, Large and Small molecules) and have been successfully applied to more than 20 different molecules.

Re-Vana is advancing eye health through both internal pipeline programs and strategic collaborations with leading ophthalmology companies. In July 2025 Re-Vana and Boehringer Ingelheim announced a strategic collaboration to develop long-acting ophthalmic therapies.

Name: T-Cypher Bio
Description:
T-Cypher was founded as a deep tech company with the mission of tackling one of the greatest unsolved challenges in human biology: How do we identify the specificities of the T cell populations that drive immune system failure, and use this knowledge to treat disease?

Solving this problem would allow us to elucidate the origins of immune-mediated disease in humans, be transformative for drug development and directly lead to the design of next-generation therapeutics.

To succeed in this mission, T-Cypher scientists designed, built and populated a unique data architecture that incorporates massive, diverse datasets relating to T cell immunology and cellular communication. This platform combines proprietary computational and wet-lab systems and today hosts data of the scale and quality required to understand T cell surveillance. We call the platform T-C Alpha.

T-Cα effectively maps both sides of the T cell immune synapse. It maps the signature peptides our body uses in the communication of health and disease, and in parallel maps the reactivity of T cell repertoires. It does this at the scale, diversity and sensitivity of the human immune system.

Today, T-Cα is a fully integrated discovery platform and machine learning engine profiling the human disease target space and its associated T cell reactivity. We use it to discover and develop next generation therapeutics for immune-mediated diseases.

Name: Queen Mary's Centre for Predictive in vitro Models
Description:
The Queen Mary University of London Centre for Predictive in vitro Models (CPM) is a world-leading research and innovation hub dedicated to advancing the use of complex in vitro models to predict human disease and therapeutic responses. The Centre brings together over 70 academic staff with multidisciplinary expertise in cell biology, tissue engineering, pharmacology, and computational modelling, working collaboratively to develop and apply cutting-edge in vitro models that are capable of simulating human biology in ways that traditional models cannot.

At its core, CPM aims to facilitate the implementation of predictive in vitro models across a broad range of disciplines, driving forward the highest quality discovery science while accelerating the delivery of safe and effective therapeutics. The Centre's vision is to provide transformative solutions that bridge the gap between laboratory-based research and real-world clinical applications. This is achieved through the development of sophisticated, high-fidelity in vitro models that can better mimic human physiology, improve drug development processes, and reduce reliance on animal testing.

The CPM's expertise spans research, training, and translation, equipping the next generation of scientists with the skills needed to harness these innovative models. The Centre actively engages in public engagement and policy shaping, working with regulators, policymakers, and the public to influence the future of biomedical science and promote the adoption of in vitro technologies in research and healthcare.

The Centre’s collaborative approach fosters strong partnerships with industry leaders, healthcare providers, and academic institutions, positioning CPM at the forefront of in vitro model development. By combining interdisciplinary expertise with cutting-edge technology, the Centre is accelerating the transition of predictive in vitro models from the laboratory to practical, real-world applications.

Name: GitLife Biotech
Description:
GitLife Biotech is a pioneering deep-tech company at the forefront of synthetic biology, offering a robust bio-digital platform (CellRepo) to improve identification and traceability of engineered biological assets for improved intellectual property (IP) protection, proof of provenance, secure collaboration and enhanced traceability to alleviate biosecurity concerns. 

Too many biotech breakthroughs get lost, stolen, or stuck in IP limbo.

It’s not your research that’s failing. It’s the tools meant to protect it.

 In fast-moving biotech environments, proving ownership shouldn’t be a guessing game. But today’s systems offer little to no visibility into who created what, when, or how.

That leads to disputes, delays, and lost revenue, especially in IP-heavy fields like synthetic biology.

 After speaking with hundreds of scientists, R&D managers, and innovation leads, here’s what we’ve learned:

• Most teams still rely on outdated manual tracking
• IP is often left exposed due to lack of version control
• Even when teams innovate fast, they can't always prove it

 That’s why we created CellRepo (GitLife).

A single collaborative platform to trace, build, protect, and share bio-innovation.

From early research to commercialization, GitLife brings structure, traceability, and security at every step of development.

Think of it like version control for biology (GitHub for Biology):

 Barcoded, traceable cells that act like "PDFs for your strains"

 A clear, tamper-proof chain of custody for every asset

 Instant proof of ownership that speeds up funding, licensing, and innovation

 Seamless integration into your existing lab workflows

Name: AbOliGo
Description:
AbOliGo (Cambridge UK, founded 2024) is developing a revolutionary platform for rapid, small-scale production of antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates (AOCs), addressing a critical bottleneck in multiplexing. AOCs are transformative tools that combine antibodies' exquisite targeting specificity with oligonucleotides' properties - DNA amplification and molecular barcoding, enabling unlimited multiplexing. However, while there are approximately 7 million commercially available antibodies, only ~0.03% are offered as AOCs.

Recognizing the growing demand for AOCs, we aim to innovate and re-imagine the manufacturing process through three key technological advancements:
 
Scale - A novel conjugation methodology that enables production at μg scale.
Quality – Develop a QC quantitative release criteria, guaranteeing batch consistency.
Fast – Manufacture and deliver AOCs from a large portfolio within days.

Renishaw Diagnostics uses novel patented technology based on Surface-Enhanced Resonance Raman Scattering (SERRS) to develop molecular diagnostic tests for the infectious disease market and for life & analytical science research applications. The main advantages of this new technology are high sensitivity, multiplex detection and analysis.

The assay is designed for use on the RenDx Multiplex Assay System, an automation and detection platform that allows processing of up to 45 samples in a single run and identifies 12 Candida and Aspergillus species. 

Our first system installation is at the San Raffaele University Hospital in Milan, Italy. The installation marks the beginning of a three month study to evaluate the Fungiplex assay in a clinical setting of both ICU and haemato-oncology populations. 

Dr Nicasio Mancini, Consultant Microbiologist, will test its performance and the possibility of its inclusion in a rapid, multi-disciplinary diagnostic flow-chart for categories of patients at high risk of invasive aspergillosis and candidemia. The identification of multiple Aspergillus and Candida species offers the potential to improve patient management of their ICU and haemato-oncology patients.
