The powerful combination of research scientists together with formulation, process and production technologies enables Cultech to provide a fully integrative manufacturing service, involving unique formulations, innovative presentation and high quality finished products.

Moreover, manufacturing flexibility and efficient customer service means that small or large scale production can be equally well accommodated.

Success within the industry in the future will increasingly rely upon innovative products to allow differentiation from competitors. Our objective is to work with our customers to help ensure that the competitive edge is maintained through innovation and quality rather than compromise.

Name: Promatix Biosciences Ltd
Description: Promatix is a data driven company that uses multi-omic information to develop a strong pipeline of novel therapeutics. We are particularly interested in the proteome, and using this in combination with other forms of omic information to gain insight into how these can vary in health and disease.

Name: Levity Crop Science Ltd
Description:
Levity Crop Science  develops sustainable agricultural inputs. Levity's products help farmers produce more and better crops, with less resource, helping move agriculture around the world towards sustainability.

Levity branded products are available through distributors. We also help incorporate our technology into third party products for out multinational partners  - helping them to produce better products.

Levity specialise in nutrient use efficiency (making fertilisers work better and at lower rates), and crop stress tolerance (helping crops grow better when the weather and soil is bad).

Name: Arktis
Description:
Arktis is a health intelligence platform at the intersection of AI and biotechnology.

Our mission is to transform how the world measures, personalizes, and optimizes human health through deep data, intelligent protocols, and precision AI.

We’re building the infrastructure for a future where health is intelligent, proactive, and radically preventative.

Rooted in science. Powered by data. Committed to longevity and sustainability through the Arktis Green Program, and the Arktis Foundation.

Name: RareMoon | Regulatory Affairs
Description:
We work exclusively on orphan drugs and advanced therapies. We advise, plan, develop, write, review, and submit regulatory dossiers.

RareMoon provides comprehensive regulatory affairs services to life science and rare disease companies, with expertise across small molecules, biologics, and a team focused on advanced therapeutic products, including cell and gene therapies.

We support sponsors at every stage, from IND preparation and accelerated pathway strategy to agency interactions,  designation planning, and fractional regulatory and clinical operations consulting services. Our team of subject-matter experts delivers regulatory strategy and execution with precision, working directly alongside sponsors to move programs forward, meeting milestones that matter.

Visit our website to hear what our clients are saying about us.

Name: Wobble Genomics Ltd
Description: Wobble Genomics is a pioneering healthcare and biotechnology company specialising in long-read RNA sequencing. Its innovative Level-Up biochemical technology enhances the detection of low-abundance RNA sequences, allowing scientists to capture all unique full-length RNA sequences in any sample. Paired with its TAMA bioinformatic technology, Wobble optimises the identification of low-level signals, using RNA biology to drive deeper insights from sequencing data

Name: Myria Biosciences AG
Description:
Myria Biosciences aims to reshape drug discovery with synthetic intelligence to engineer natural-product inspired chemical compounds for pharma and biotech challenges.

The company's GEMMS (Genetically Engineered Modular Molecule Scaffolds) platform combines synthetic biology and artificial intelligence into a synthetic intelligence approach that allows therapeutic compound design and biological production far beyond what nature's evolution has provided. 
Myria is unlocking new chemical space and generating optimized molecular candidates with unprecedented speed and precision for unmet medical needs.

Name: AMPLY Discovery
Description:
Most of the genome is uncharted. We drew a map.

AMPLY Discovery is a UK biotech turning the 98% of the genome largely ignored by drug developers into a pipeline of first-in-class therapeutics. Running six AI engines and two wet labs across one closed loop between silicon and bench.

Based in Belfast, Northern Ireland. Spin-out from Queen's University Belfast.

Name: Molecular Dimensions
Description:
Molecular Dimensions is a supplier of modern screens and reagents for protein structure determination by X-ray crystallography. We stock a wide variety of products for protein crystallography including bacterial growth media, ready-to-use selenomethioine expression media, crystallization screens, crystallization plates and cryocrystallography. We also supply crystal growth incubators and automated solutions for crystal growth imaging and analysis with UV fluorescence. Owing to our comprehensive range of products we are widely recognised as the world leader in membrane protein crystallization.

Have any questions? Contact us at enquiries@moleculardimensions.com!

Name: ABbiotek Health
Description: ABbiotek Health is a dynamic life sciences company. We supply the pharma, medical nutrition, food, nutraceutical, and pet care markets with specialised microbiome modulating solutions using fermentation technology involving bacteria, yeasts, and enzymes (BYE). These solutions support niche—yet globally prevalent—health disorders across six health platforms: digestive, immune, mobility, metabolic, central nervous system, and women’s health. They serve as a preventative option or, at times, complement traditional medicine. We protect the microbiome with tailored delivery systems, from the active ingredient to the finished products.
Location: Kingston upon Hull, England, United Kingdom

Name: Apitope
Description:
Apitope is a clinical stage biotech company developing potential first-in-class antigen-specific immunotherapeutics targeting the immunological basis of autoimmune diseases.

We use our novel, proprietary discovery platform to select and develop highly specific peptide-based therapies, known as “apitopes”, which restore the natural balance (immune tolerance) of the immune system. This mechanism of action avoids global immune suppression and has the broad potential to treat a wide variety of autoimmune diseases.

Apitope’s lead product candidate ATX-MS-1467 is in clinical development for treating multiple sclerosis (“MS”). ATX-MS-1467 is the first potential therapeutic for MS that combines high efficacy with an excellent, and thereby differentiating, safety profile.

Apitope’s other lead product candidate ATX-GD-59 demonstrates potential to be the first disease-modifying treatment for Graves' disease and the first potential innovative treatment for the disease in more than 60 years.

In addition, Apitope has developed a robust pipeline with several innovative, potential first-in-class product candidates advancing towards clinical development for the treatment of, amongst other indications, uveitis, factor VIII inhibitors, myocarditis, and rheumatoid arthritis.

Founded in 2002, Apitope has an experienced leadership team with a strong track record in the pharmaceutical industry and scientific community.

Name: Leaf Expression Systems
Description:
Leaf Expression Systems is an established contract research and product development company working to serve the global life sciences, consumer product, agribiotech and cellular food industries. Its expert team specialise in producing high-value proteins and biomolecules for use in research and product development.

For more information about Leaf and its research and development services, visit its website leafexpressionsystems.com

Name: ClientPharma
Description:
At ClientPharma, we are a certified veteran-owned pharmaceutical services and supply company with a global presence across the UK, EU, US, LATAM and APAC. Founded in 2013 by Gary Campbell, a military veteran with 24 years of service, we bring over 180 years of combined pharmaceutical experience to support the needs of global clinical studies.

Our expertise lies in navigating the complexities of sourcing essential commercial pharmaceutical products for research, specializing in comparators, rescue medications, standard-of-care treatments, and more. We understand that reliable supply chains and supplier diversity are critical to successful clinical trials. By fostering a diverse network of suppliers, we reduce supply risks and enhance access to high-quality treatments, keeping trials on track worldwide.

At ClientPharma, our commitment extends beyond efficient service. We build strong partnerships grounded in trust, open communication, and a deep commitment to understanding and addressing our clients' and suppliers’ needs. This collaborative approach ensures precision, responsiveness, and reliability in every project.

Partner with ClientPharma, a certified veteran-owned global business, to make a lasting impact on clinical trials. Contact us today to discuss how our experience and dedication to diversity can support your clinical trial supply needs.
Location: Burton upon Trent, England, United Kingdom

Name: aVaxziPen
Description:
aVaxziPen formulate a wide range of vaccine types into solid dose vaccines.  Solid dose vaccines are highly thermostable and are highly immunogenic - offering fridge free and antigen sparing vaccine formulations.  The solid doses are delivered using our needle-free, multi-use pen.   
aVaxziPen is a trading name of aVaxMed Limited.

Name: CARMA - Cellular Agriculture Manufacturing Hub
Description:
CARMA (Cellular AgRiculture MAnufacturing) Hub is an EPSRC-funded transdisciplinary seven year project focused on developing novel approaches to making food products. 

Cellular agriculture is the production of food and other consumables, traditionally grown on the land/in the sea, in a bioprocess by utilizing cells. 

Our Vision is for a just transition to environmentally, economically, and socially sustainable food systems. 

Our Mission is the integration of transdisciplinary responsible approaches, for novel cellular agriculture tools and technologies, into current food systems, to deliver sustainable food manufacturing in the UK and beyond.

Led by the University of Bath, this multidisciplinary project also includes colleagues from the University of Birmingham, University of Aberystwyth, University College London and the Royal Agricultural University, as well as a range of industrial partners. Together we have an array of expertise spanning the underpinning sciences, engineering, and social sciences.

Name: AlgiSys
Description:
AlgiSys is a B2B ingredient company that uses biotechnology to produce EPA omega-3 and plant protein ingredients from microalgae, replacing fish as the source of these important nutrients. 

AlgiSys provides an environmentally safe and sustainable alternative to fish sources in the Omega-3 industry where climate change and demand are rapidly depleting wild fish populations, polluting our oceans, and jeopardizing other life sustaining natural resources. 

AlgiSys has patented algal technology capable of replacing fish oil as a primary source for EPA omega-3 creating the only environmentally sustainable and economically viable source for high quality EPA products, using proven and cost efficient production methods for the aquaculture, supplement, food & beverage, animal and pet nutrition, pharmaceutical, cosmetics, and other industries.

Name: Concinnity Genetics
Description: Concinnity is developing an AI-driven RNA design platform to build gene control systems for gene and cell therapies. Our RNA-based control systems will form part of the gene therapy cassette and enable precise control of therapeutic activity. Such control systems have huge potential to enhance both patient safety and therapeutic efficacy, for example by allowing a gene therapy to dynamically adjust its activity in response to patient disease state, recognise tissue type, or by allowing clinical control of the therapy after administration.

Name: uFraction8
Description:
uFraction8 builds products around a disruptive new liquid particle processing technology. Following our world leading research, establishing new levels of throughput for massively multiplexed microfluidic devices, our technology will be the key to unlock a prosperous and sustainable future.

Our technology offers superior performance and cost savings against the big three liquid processing technologies of filtration, flow centrifugation and flocculation. High volume applications benefit by our unique ability to granularly match targeted volumetric throughputs and our ability to scale this beyond the physical limitations of competing technologies.

Maintaining an unobstructed flow path allows our technology to continue operation in even high suspended solid applications, with operation up to 46% volume fraction maintaining 99.6% +/-0.3% efficiency. Recovery of targeted particles is not hampered by penetration into pores, allowing unmatched recovery from low initial concentration. Particles can be selected out by size with single digit micron precision to ensure only those of interest are extracted, simplifying any subsequent detection or processing.

Our planned products will benefit the world in substantial ways, enhancing food security, increasing access to medicines and nutrients, preserving ocean life and enhancing operational capabilities of humanitarian aid missions.

Beginning our journey, developments are focusing on the most immediately impactful area of sustainable bioproduction. Hampered by the high costs of downstream processing from closed bioreactor systems, our products energy efficiency, non-dependence on consumables or pre-concentration and scalability will unlock economies of scale to achieve dramatic increase in global biomass production. Made with SS316L wettable components, customers using fresh or saltwater producing acids, bases, solvents and aromatics can safely scale their production capabilities and drastically reduce their costs.

Name: Cryoniss
Description:
Cryoniss is a UK-based outsourced managed service provider of temperature-controlled, biological sample storage and cold-chain logistics solutions, founded by former senior leaders of the global AstraZeneca cell banking operation, Sonia Houghton and Phil Hargreaves.
 
Whether you need support to source, store and manage your team’s daily access to high-quality human samples for biobanking research purposes, or require somewhere to store clinical samples beyond the trial, we can provide a tailored solution that works for you, with next day access to samples throughout the UK as standard. We are also located ideally to coordinate the distribution of your samples worldwide, saving you hours of non-value-added time on the phone navigating customs requirements.

Regulated storage of biological samples in vapour phase liquid nitrogen (-196°C), -80°C, -20°C, +4°C and ambient temperature.
Next-day dispatch and receipt of samples with simple and streamlined processes.
21 CFR Part 11 and ISO9001-compliant laboratory monitoring systems.
Secure, HIPAA compliant, cloud-based laboratory inventory management system.

Regulated to store the following samples:

•	HTA regulated material
•	GMO up to and including class II
•	APHA High risk category 2 animal by-products.
•	MHRA WDA (Human)

We set no minimum sample numbers – from a single sample upwards, we can accommodate your request.

Clear pay-on-demand pricing model. Only pay for the samples you store, month on month, with no hidden costs.

Our bespoke, secure facilities mean your samples are monitored 24/7/365.

We work to GDP, GLP & GCP standards.

Our audit-ready procedures provide you with complete confidence.

Our comprehensive business continuity back-up plans mean your samples are secure should the worst happen.

Cyber-Essentials Plus accredited - the security of your data is a priority.

Cryoniss – Built by scientists, for scientists.

Name: Tay Therapeutics Ltd
Description: Tay Therapeutics is a UK-based biotech headquartered in Dundee, overlooking the River Tay. We are dedicated to developing targeted small molecule therapies to address diseases with high unmet medical need.

Name: Xterna
Description: Harnessing nature's barcodes for cell specific targeting.

Name: Zentraxa
Description: Zentraxa’s proprietary technological platform, Zentide, combined with our extensive technical know-how allows us to push the boundaries of what can be achieved with synthetic biopolymers. We specialise in the design, production and testing of complex novel peptides and, as a result of our Zentide platform, can circumvent the previously existing bio-design limits of conventional peptide synthesis with one universal process.

Name: SYNthesis med chem
Description:
SYNthesis (www.synmedchem.com) is a chemistry-focussed, contract research organisation providing custom synthesis and medicinal chemistry services.
The company was established in 2007 and operates a unique, hybrid business model combining medicinal chemistry & project management expertise based in both Australia and the USA, with high quality synthetic chemistry based in China. 
In addition to Melbourne (Australia) where SYNthesis med chem's global headquarters are located, the company also has operations in Shanghai & Suzhou (China) together with offices in the UK and USA.
SYNthesis currently employs over 250 chemists based in Australia, China & the USA.
Our medicinal chemists provide the design, innovation, creativity and problem solving expertise required to complement the skills & capabilities of the company's expert team of synthetic chemists based in China.
Our medicinal chemists are all experienced and highly skilled scientists with a track record of delivering clinical candidates, a passion for discovering new medicines and a comprehensive insight gained from managing more than 100 projects covering all phases of the pharmaceutical R&D process. 
They also act as project managers for custom synthesis and medicinal chemistry projects.

Name: Cogitat
Description: Award-winning deep learning technology delivering precise brain activity decoding - from attention to movement control - across any EEG device.

Name: Spirea
Description:
Spirea is at the forefront of revolutionising cancer and beyond with our cutting-edge ELIVATE linker technology. 

Our innovative approach significantly expands the payload repertoire for antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), enabling the next generation of targeted therapies. By leveraging ELIVATE’s multivalent capabilities, we optimise therapeutic outcomes, ensuring precise drug delivery and enhanced pharmacokinetics.

Our dedicated team of experts is committed to advancing our proprietary ADC pipeline and forming strategic partnerships to maximise the potential of our technology. Join us on our mission to transform patient care and deliver groundbreaking treatments across a wide range of diseases.

Explore how Spirea is unlocking the full potential of ADCs at www.spirea.co.uk

Name: SökerData
Description: AI-powered platform that accelerates access to correlated genomic and clinical datasets from under-represented groups (women and Black and ethnic minorities) in breast cancer and cardiovascular diseases.

Name: LivFul, Inc.
Description: LivFul is an unconventional life science company that prioritizes health access and impact before profit maximization. We discover, develop and distribute health innovations through our global partners, including academia, NGOs, micro-businesses, and multinational corporations. Our goal is to ensure that everyone has access to the best health innovations so that we can all live free, live well and live to our full potential.

Name: VH Bio
Description:
VH Bio Limited is a leading supply and distribution company for the life sciences industry within the United Kingdom and Republic of Ireland, specialising in key areas of science including Transplant Diagnostics, Molecular Biology, Immunology and Cell Biology.

VH Bio strives to provide the highest level of customer service and satisfaction, placing our customers at the forefront of our business. Our experienced and dedicated field-based technical representatives, supported by two Product Managers, provide a wealth of knowledge and expertise to customers throughout the sales cycle. In addition, VH Bio further supports its customers by providing consultation and technical services; product training, wet workshops and after-sales support both in-house and off-site in the field.

Follow us on Twitter: twitter.com/@VHBio

Name: Guilford Street Laboratories
Description: At Guilford Street Laboratories (GSL), a UCL spin-out, we are dedicated to helping our clients achieve their research objectives. Leveraging machine learning-driven mass spectrometry, we deliver highly precise and sensitive biomarker panels, specializing in the analysis of protein, lipid, and metabolite markers. Whether your focus is on early disease diagnosis, drug discovery, collaboration as a partner in an EU Horizon consortium, clinical trials, or personalized medicine, our team is here to help.

Name: pixlbio (formerly Phenaros)
Description:
pixlbio is redefining predictive biology.

Formed from the merger of DefiniGEN (UK) and Phenaros (Sweden), we combine iPSC-derived human models with high-throughput imaging and AI-powered phenomics to uncover subtle cellular insights that animal models can’t.

Our platform captures millions of images and profiles hundreds of millions of cells each week, turning complex biology into predictive clarity for drug discovery and safety.

What we offer:
- iPSC-derived hepatocytes, stellates & intestinal organoids
- Validated disease models (MASLD/MASH, A1ATD, Wilson’s)
- AI-driven phenomics
- Proprietary automation and SaaS access

Trusted by 11 of the top 20 pharma companies, leading biotechs, and research institutions worldwide.

We’re ISO 9001:2015 certified and expanding into cardiac and renal models — building the next generation of predictive biology.

 Every cell tells a story. Every pixel holds a clue.

Name: Stemgent
Description:
Stemgent is a brand of REPROCELL, a leading supplier of cellular reprogramming products and services and tissue-based research, Under the Stemgent brand, REPROCELL provides a comprehensive portfolio of tools for cell research, and is recognized as expert in stem cell reprogramming, provide mRNA reprogramming systems, cell culture media, antibodies, small molecules, and iPS reprogramming services.

ReproCELL Incorporated
ReproCELL was established as a venture company originating from the University of Tokyo and Kyoto University and has been the pioneer in the iPS cell business, succeeding in the commercialization of the world's first human iPS cell products in 2009 and with the world's most advanced research and technology. In addition, through the recent acquisitions of Reinnervate (UK), BioServe (US), and Stemgent (US), ReproCELL is proceeding towards the establishment of a global distribution network, and technology synergy and new product introductions.

Name: Glen Clova Scientific
Description:
Glen Clova Scientific (GCS) is disrupting biologic therapeutic treatment pathways with its unique VLP platform that delivers powerful and accessible therapeutics.

With its proprietary virus-like particle (VLP) platform delivering targeted immune modulation, the company is delivering a disruptive alternative to monoclonal antibodies – with lower and faster development cost. The GCS platform is widely applicable for development of vaccines, oncology therapeutics, infectious disease therapeutics and in immune-inflammatory disease.

Name: NonExomics
Description:
NonExomics, Inc is a scientists-led company that has pioneered the discovery process of the new wave of targets from the so-called Dark Genome. Over the last 8 years, we have meticulously developed AI-based algorithms deployed on the patient data at a population scale, to discover over 250,000 new proteins and investigated their disruptions in over 1365 human diseases. We have performed extensive in silico and experimental validation on these new targets to develop them as diagnostics and therapeutics.
Our target portfolio serves as a parallel universe in drug discovery that is ripe to be challenged by the available therapeutic modalities in various diseases. 

We welcome opportunities to collaborate with other partners in challenging these newly-found genes using small molecules, antisense oligos, antibodies, gene therapy, etc.

Name: AbBaltis
Description:
At AbBaltis, we take pride in providing high-quality disease state plasma, serum, and residual clinical samples to the In Vitro Diagnostics industry and research community.

Our offerings include residual clinical samples for proof-of-concept research or regulatory data submissions, bulk disease state plasma for production or quality control, and defibrinated/delipidated double charcoal stripped plasma for spike-in and recovery experiments.

We are dedicated to delivering friendly and efficient customer service, supporting our customers from early R&D efforts through to manufacturing.

Are you passionate about advancing diagnostics and research? Interested in joining our dynamic team? Email hr@abbaltis.com for more information and explore the exciting opportunities we offer!

Name: Draper Lab Group
Description: The research undertaken in the Draper group focuses on the development of novel and improved approaches to malaria vaccine design, as well as aiming to better understand molecular mechanisms of vaccine-induced immunity to blood-stage malaria infection.

Name: Toraphene
Description:
We’re a UK materials company with a patented platform that reinforces compostable polymers with graphene, creating certified compostable material that outperforms conventional plastic on strength, durability and barrier protection.

Our compostable bin bags are UK-made, independently tested, and have sold over seven million units. And bin bags are just the start.

Sustainable materials have always asked people to choose: do the right thing, or get the performance you need. Toraphene ends that trade-off.

Plastic was a performance breakthrough. Toraphene is what comes next, because we have to do better than plastic.

Name: HUID
Description: HUID is on a mission to reduce our single waste plastic consumption, by exploring the potential of onion skins.  Utilizing the vast amounts of Allium waste we generate globally, HUID aims to create various material applications that are better for the planet.

Name: Mironid Limited
Description: Mironid Limited is an innovative new drug discovery company that develops proprietary drug candidate molecules by modulating the activity of key cell signalling proteins. This allows us to access multiple therapeutic areas for exploitation. Our lead programme is in the area of rare genetic kidney disease.

Name: Causeway Sensors Limited
Description: Causeway Sensors uses nanotechnology to provide better candidate selection during drug development. The company spun-out after years of high-impact research at Queen's University Belfast. Our unique nanochip platform brings real-time, label-free kinetic analysis to areas of biotherapeutic production where such data cannot currently be collected. More data at critical points of production helps pharma companies ensure that only the best drug candidates progress to clinical trials. The platform can be incorporated into a multitude of form factors, ranging from a high-throughput screening instrument to an in-line cell culture monitoring tool.

Name: Oxford Cancer Biomarkers
Description:
Oxford Cancer Biomarkers translates ground-breaking scientific discovery into predictive biomarker diagnostic products that allow medicines to be personalised for the benefit of the cancer patient. Oxford Cancer Biomarkers is a spin-out of the University of Oxford and has strong links with the Medical Sciences Division in Oxford University. The company was founded by Nick La Thangue, Ph.D., Chair of Cancer Biology at Oxford University and David Kerr, CBE, D.Sc., M.D. FMedSci, Professor of Cancer Medicine at Oxford University. Investors in OCB include Longwall Venture Partners LLP, Esperante BV, Ningbo My-BioMed Biotechnology Co.,Ltd., CancerRop Co. Ltd., and the University of Oxford.

Oxford Cancer Biomarkers range of predictive biomarkers will help clinicians deliver personalised care to patients with colorectal cancer. The first to be launched is ToxNav, a 20 SNP germline assay that predicts individuals’ propensity to develop life-threatening adverse reactions from 5FU/capecitabine chemotherapy. OncoProg; a digital pathology test for the recurrence of Stage II tumours is already available in China. The company is working with academic partners to develop a population-based genome test for the lifetime risk of developing colorectal cancer.

Name: Labtech International Ltd
Description:
Labtech was established in January 1993 and is a leading supplier and service provider for highly innovative scientific instruments and consumables.  Key market sectors include molecular & cell biology and detection, plus a specialist electron microscopy and imaging division.

Labtech supports this technology-based portfolio thought a highly qualified team of customer focused applications and sales specialists. The service team is very experienced and offers a high level of customer support throughout the UK.

Name: GutSee Health
Description: GutSee is transforming the future of gut health, starting with a game-changing approach to diagnosing and treating Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS). By decoding gut signatures with cutting-edge science, our revolutionary AI-Discovery platform fuses multi-omics data and AI modelling to unlock the complex microbiome-host interactions behind IBS. We go beyond symptoms, targeting the root cause with precision microbiome modulation therapy, enhanced by custom CRISPR-like nucleases to restore gut balance and provide lasting relief. Get ready for a new era in gut health!

Name: Attomarker
Description:
Our mission is to revolutionise the field of diagnostics by providing rapid, accurate, and quantified point-of-care testing solutions. We strive to empower healthcare professionals with advanced technologies that enhance speed-to-care, leading to improved patient outcomes and ultimately saving lives.

What We Have Delivered - 
A significant pipeline of tests currently focused on the most important global health challenges: Post-viral syndromes like Long Covid, COVID-19, Liver Health, Diabetes, Obesity, and Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR).

Currently the Company’s Long Covid research test is available in the UK, Switzerland, Cyprus with plans to roll out in the USA, India, Singapore and the Cayman Islands. It’s an exciting time for Attomarker but perhaps even more so for the patients served by its innovative gold-based nanophotonic technology.

Background - 
Attomarker is a British company which developed a technology for measuring multiple biomarkers in blood and saliva to provide a multi-dimensional health profile in 7-10 minutes. The data can be used by patients to make more informed decisions about their health, wellbeing and protection, and by healthcare professionals to determine a personalised patient healthcare pathway across multiple healthcare settings at the bedside, in the operating theatre, in the pharmacy and at home.

It was founded in 2008, and spun out from Professor Andrew Shaw’s research group at the University of Exeter. It has won numerous prestigious awards for innovation and been awarded grants for research from the UK Government due to the importance of its work.

If you wish to find out more about our technology please visit our website www.attomarker.com or contact us directly via email at info@attomarker.com

Name: Serenatis Bio
Description:
Serenatis Bio is a Cambridge-based biotechnology company that is developing novel, precision therapeutics for obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) — a severe and often misunderstood mental health condition affecting over 240 million people worldwide.

Yet, despite its scale, innovation in OCD treatment has been severely limited for over thirty years. Current options (mainly SSRIs and CBT) can also be slow to act, difficult to access, and largely ineffective. This means up to 60% of patients are left without meaningful relief and suffering from additional side effects. 

But Serenatis is taking a different approach.

Founded in 2024 by experienced drug developers, the company is advancing a pipeline of three novel small-molecule therapies - each targeting a distinct neurobiological driver of OCD and possessing a novel mechanism of action. In parallel, Serenatis is also integrating precision medicine techniques that will match patients with the treatments most likely to benefit them.

And this progress has not gone unnoticed. 

To date, the company has been widely recognised for its innovative approach and strong scientific foundation - attracting support from leading investors and the wider biotech ecosystem. This includes being named the BioSeed “One to Watch”, recognised as a company to watch in the #21toWatch top21.2026 list, and shortlisted as a finalist for both the bionow Startup of the Year and One Nucleus Best Therapeutic R&D Programme awards.

Given this differentiated pipeline, strong scientific rationale, and growing momentum, Serenatis Bio is positioned at the forefront of innovation in neuropsychiatry — creating both meaningful patient impact and significant long-term value.

Name: GENOMIC INSTITUTE
Description:
Our organization is a pioneering Bioinformatics Training Centre and Laboratory committed to empowering the next generation of scientists across Africa. With a core mission to reach, teach, and impact, we serve a diverse community of students, researchers, lecturers, biotech organizations, medical laboratory scientists, interns, and life science professionals.

We offer hands-on, interdisciplinary training that bridges both wet and dry lab experiences—ensuring participants gain deep expertise in molecular biology techniques alongside cutting-edge computational bioinformatics. Our curriculum is designed not only to build technical proficiency but also to foster innovation and entrepreneurial thinking, enabling participants to transform scientific knowledge into real-world solutions for Africa’s unique health, agricultural, and environmental challenges.

By integrating high-impact teaching, research mentorship, and skill-based training, we aim to cultivate a new wave of bioinformatics leaders equipped to drive scientific discovery, address critical local problems, and contribute meaningfully to the global life sciences ecosystem.

Name: Constant Systems
Description:
Manufacture and Design of High Pressure Cell Disruption equipment.

Since 1989 Constant Systems has been committed to the design, development, manufacture and aftermarket support of cell disruption equipment. It is this dedication and hard work that is quickly making Constant Systems the first choice supplier for Pharmaceutical/Biotech companies, Research Institutes, Universities and Schools worldwide

Name: Briefly Bio
Description: We're reviving all those robots purchased on some equipment call years ago, which have been collecting dust in the corner. No need for coding or automation engineers to prototype your assays. Show up with a rough plan – and Briefly will help you to figure out the rest.

Name: DNA Worldwide Group Ltd
Description:
DNA Worldwide is a specialist DNA, Hair Drug & Alcohol testing company providing a comprehensive range of home and legal DNA tests. DNA Worldwide concentrates on quality and customer service certified to ISO 9001:2008. It exceeds all UK and international requirements for testing through its ISO:17025 certified partner laboratory. All tests are dealt with discretely, efficiently and are subject to the highest levels of security with accuracy of 100%.

A team of over 200 leading industry scientists is backed up by dedicated and supportive customer care, regularly dealing with paternity testing for family disputes, immigration testing as well as more complex testing of special specimens. The company also offers siblingship, Aunt/Uncle testing and Grandparent testing.

Name: Cellestial Health
Description:
We know that the whole brain suffers in disease - yet only one half of it is protected by approved drugs.

Cellestial Health is a pharmaceutical spin-out from the University of Cambridge developing small molecule drugs that protect an overlooked half of the brain – networks of brain cells called astrocytes, to stop progression of Parkinson's and other neurological conditions.

Name: Woost
Description:
Woost is aiming to track biomarkers in menstrual blood to help women with the diagnosis of gynaecological conditions.
Learn more about us on our Instagram channel: @woosthealth

Name: GenomeByte
Description:
GenomeByte is a multiomics research platform at the interface of microbiology and data science. It delivers customized experimental and bioinformatics workflows to study microbial genomics, infection biology, host–pathogen interactions, antimicrobial resistance (AMR), and applied microbiology.

Message us here or drop us a line at: info@genomebyte.com

Name: Apto-Gen
Description:
Apto-Gen is a technology-driven company dedicated to providing customized PCR and qPCR solutions for our customers’ applications. We manufacture market-leading molecular biology reagents for direct integration into test devices and assays for both human and animal diagnostics companies.

Specializing in lyophilization-compatible enzyme and reagent technologies, we offer more environmentally sustainable products by reducing cold chain storage and product wastage.

We identify with our customers’ quality systems and meet their specific design requirements and project time frames to deliver bespoke and innovative products.

Name: HotHouse Therapeutics
Description:
HotHouse Therapeutics is rewriting the future of drug discovery with BotanAI and BotanBio - our AI and plant bioengineering platforms that design and make molecules labs can’t reach. 

By transforming plants into sustainable biofactories, we unlock vast new chemical space, creating next-generation vaccine adjuvants and breakthrough therapeutics in days, not years.

The urgency is clear: 62% of today’s medicines are natural or nature-inspired, yet conventional chemistry is slow, expensive, and environmentally harmful. As a sustainable biotech, our approach is different. Because our medicines grow in plants, they scale through vertical farming, are carbon-positive by design, and avoid destructive extraction.

With deep expertise in plant science, chemistry, and AI, we’re building not just a pipeline, but a platform - delivering next-generation medicines that are greener, faster, and smarter.

Name: BIOCAPTIVA LIMITED
Description:
BIOCAPTIVA is an award-winning biotechnology company based in Edinburgh, dedicated to revolutionising liquid biopsy and nucleic acid (NA) extraction. Harnessing our proprietary msXTM polymer technology, we are addressing critical challenges in the liquid biopsy market, empowering breakthroughs in genetic disease detection, diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment.

Our advanced extraction method ensures unparalleled cell-free NA yield and quality, driving progress in precision medicine and multi-omics research.

What Sets Us Apart: Our Patented NA-Binding Polymers

Our innovative, biocompatible NA-binding polymers offer unmatched benefits:

Flexibility: Customisable coatings for diverse substrate formats, including bead-based systems and automated workflows.

Versatility: Effortlessly captures cell-free NAs from simple and complex solutions without the need for additional reagents or preservatives.

PRICE
Laboratory-based diagnostics are expensive, to the individual, the insurer, and the system. By lowering the price of modern diagnostics, we dramatically increase their use and value within healthcare.

ACCURACY
The Senzo Amplified Lateral Flow test is PCR-accurate. This means that for the first time we can bring testing for a range of new infections and diseases out of the laboratory and closer to the patient enabling a revolution in both diagnostics and treatments.

SIMPLICITY
Current diagnostics are too complex. From appointments to samples to laboratories to results. By simplifying diagnostics and bringing accurate and real-time testing to the patient, we can save money, save resources and save lives.

SPEED
Testing is about accurate results. The faster we can return a diagnosis, the sooner we can begin a treatment. Currently, patients and health care professionals often wait days for results. Real-time testing changes this forever, removing the gaps between consultation, testing, data and treatment.

ACCESSIBILITY
Accurate diagnostics today remain unevenly distributed. The only way to bring testing to patients in lower-income areas is to replace the complex central laboratory model with an affordable point-of-care diagnostics system without sacrificing accuracy.

•  Human safety assays: predict adverse effects in healthy human tissues
•  Human efficacy assays: use diseased human tissues to demonstrate drug efficacy
•  Human absorption assays: use respiratory and gastrointestinal tissues to predict drug absorption

This invaluable human data is available during early discovery and development phases and helps reduce the number of compounds which fail in the later stages of drug development. Find out more by visiting our website.

Name: QCMD
Description:
Quality Control for Molecular Diagnostics (QCMD) is one of the leading  independent International External Quality Assessment / Proficiency Testing organisations.  Providing  wide-ranging quality assessment services primarily focused on molecular diagnosis of infectious diseases to in excess of 2200 laboratories and clinical settings in over 100 countries. 

QCMD is dedicated to driving the quality of our participants molecular diagnostics through assessment, benchmarking and knowledge transfer, via the creation of insight and thought leadership developed in partnership with leading international scientific experts.

QCMD evolved from the successful European Union Concerted Action programmes which were initiated in the early 1990s to address quality control within the clinical diagnosis of viral Meningitis and Encephalitis. The QC programmes were expanded in 1998 through the establishment of a European Union funded project Quality Control Concerted Action (EU-QCCA). This enabled the issues of quality and standardisation to be reviewed in the wider context of diagnostic clinical virology and microbiology through the provision of QC material, proficiency testing (PT) or external quality assessment (EQA), and consensus best practice approaches.

The EU-QCCA established a very successful international network and educational EQA scheme. One of the principal objectives of the EU-QCCA was to provide a mechanism for the long-term continuation of the international programmes. QCMD was founded in 2001 to continue and expand the work as an independent provider of External Quality Assessment programmes for molecular diagnostics.

Description:

Our current focal point is the field of extracellular vesicles (EVs), which have recently gained substantial traction as a next-generation therapeutic modality. We believe that current approaches have room for improvement in terms of consistency and efficacy, which is where we come in. Our suite of immortal MSC lines represent an endless source of therapeutically active EVs, eliminating the need for donor source material. Combined with an in-house chemically defined medium, we can provide improved batch consistency, while reducing cost of goods and reducing regulatory burden. 
Our initial target is osteoarthritis, which presents an unprecedented socioeconomic burden as populations age and no disease modifying drugs exist. With our MSC-derived EVs, we have shown that we can exert a strong anti-inflammatory effect, with the added capability of specific cargo delivery. 
Our MSC-EV production platform is an agile, versatile means of producing therapeutic EVs for any application at improved consistency.

Name: iosBio
Description:
iosBio believes that thermally stable, self-administered vaccines in capsule form are the future. Due to its OraProTM platform, these are inexpensive to produce, developed in weeks and, following regulatory approval, can be distributed by mail. 

iosBio is using this approach to tackle the global COVID-19 pandemic, developing a capsule-based vaccine that could be easily distributed to millions across the globe. This comes after successfully working on an oral vaccine for the Zika virus.

iosBio’s OraProTM technology means these thermally stable viral vector-based vaccines can be delivered in capsule form to the GI tract. Viral vectors result in vaccines being developed cheaply and quickly, while administration via the gut elicits both mucosal and systemic immunity and allows for repeated administration of the same vector. In contrast, injected viral vector injections only target systemic immunity and can be used just once or twice as immunity to the vector itself is developed.

This is made possible by iosBio’s THERM-SB technology. It allows for the storage of vaccines and viruses in powder form at ambient temperatures, eliminating the need for a cold chain to protect vaccines and other biotherapeutics when being delivered and in storage. 

Adopting this method can redefine the global approach to virus immunity. It will reduce our current reliance on often impractical mass vaccination programmes. These are based on injections that require huge numbers of healthcare professionals and expensive global cold-chains or even a -800C cryo-chain.

Through a combination of THERM-SB and OraProTM, iosBio is making its vision for an oral vaccine future a reality.

Description:
At Cytox our mission is enable everyone to know their personal risk for Alzheimer's disease.
 
Alzheimer’s disease today affects over 46 million people globally and this is projected to reach 75 million by 2030 and over 131 million people by 2050.

Cytox has developed genoSCORETM technology that assesses over 100,000 bits of DNA to compute an individual's genetic risk of developing Alzheimer's disease as a single risk score. This technology forms the basis of a Polygenic Risk Score test for Alzheimer's disease that is available in the US and the UK. 

In the US, the Alzheimer’s Risk Test is available from Sampled SMART Labs (www.Sampled.com), who developed it based on genoSCORETM technology supplied by Cytox. In the UK, information about the test can be found at www.genoscore-lab.com. 

The benefits of genetic testing include understanding the importance of taking action to reduce the chance of developing Alzheimer's disease, because AD risk isn’t just about genetics. Lifestyle and environmental factors play a significant role, too. One of the advantages of a personal risk score is that it can provide the motivation to make lifestyle adjustments, although being prepared for the result is an essential requirement for anyone who goes down the testing route.

We specialise in manufacturing pheromones, traps and lures used to compliment and promote sustainable integrated pest management (IPM) in predominantly agriculture, horticulture, storage, urban and forestry settings. Name: The Vaccine Group (TVG)
Description:
The Vaccine Group (TVG) develops next-generation animal vaccines using a proprietary herpesvirus vector platform designed to deliver durable, early-life protection against high-impact infectious diseases.

TVG focuses on diseases where existing vaccines underperform – particularly in the presence of maternal antibodies – and where improved immunity can reduce disease burden, productivity losses, and antibiotic use in livestock.

The platform is being advanced across economically significant livestock diseases, including bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV) and Streptococcus suis, as well as selected zoonotic and emerging infections where vaccination of animal reservoirs offers a pragmatic route to reducing human exposure risk.

TVG advances vaccine candidates to in vivo proof-of-concept and partners with established animal health companies for late-stage development, manufacturing and commercialisation through focused licensing and co-development agreements.

Founder Origin Story

The Vaccine Group was founded by Professor Michael Jarvis, whose path into science began far from the laboratory. He began his working life as a sheet metal worker and welder after leaving school at 15 in rural England. A move to the United States to live with an aunt who kept 28 Irish wolfhounds redirected his path toward veterinary science and ultimately into virology.

Along the way, the guidance of exceptional mentors during his studies in California and at the University of Cambridge helped shape a deep curiosity about how biological systems work at a mechanistic level. That curiosity guided three decades of research developing herpesvirus-based vaccine technologies. 

This work became the scientific foundation of The Vaccine Group, established to translate these innovations into next-generation vaccines designed to deliver early-life protection in animal health.

Name: Genome Therapeutics
Description:
Founded in 2022, Genome Therapeutics (GTx) was formed to advance pioneering academic research from the laboratories of Professor Sir Shankar Balasubramanian at the University of Cambridge and Professor Samuel Aparicio at the University of British Colombia. GTx is developing novel therapies that target secondary DNA structures called G-quadruplexes (G4) that are overrepresented in cancer cells.
 
This novel approach to cancer therapeutics is underpinned by 25 years’ of academic research, paving the way for GTx to develop first-in-class therapies that precisely target the underlying genetic drivers of cancer and avoid the indiscriminate toxicity profile of classical chemotherapy agents.

Name: Lab Optimise Ltd
Description:
The industry invests heavily in better instruments. We believe laboratories deserve a better way to manage them.
Lab Optimise provides service, maintenance, calibration, qualification and repair across the full laboratory estate through one accountable route.
Most labs do not choose supplier complexity. It builds gradually — one instrument, warranty, contract and renewal at a time. Soon the lab is managing suppliers, visits, quotes, reports, certificates, faults and follow-ups that all compete for time and attention.
That creates supplier friction. It creates operational drag. And it pulls focus away from the work the lab exists to do.
Lab Optimise was formed to change that.
We do not manufacture instruments. We do not sell instruments. Our focus is helping laboratories keep existing equipment reliable, compliant and cost-effective for longer.
We bring together cross-OEM, cross-category and cross-discipline technical capability through proven engineers and specialist service expertise. This gives laboratories one practical route for planned service, instrument faults, documentation, follow-up actions and technical support across mixed estates.
We support a broad mix of analytical, microbiological and general laboratory equipment, from chromatography, spectroscopy, balances, pipettes and centrifuges to tablet testing, temperature-controlled equipment, laboratory water systems and core bench instruments.
Instrument history builds over time. Engineers arrive with better context. Reports, certificates and actions keep moving.
To the lab, it feels less like managing suppliers and more like having an in-house service team to turn to whenever something instrument-related is needed.
Most of our work is in pharmaceutical and healthcare laboratories, where uptime, compliance and service confidence matter every day.
Everything in your lab. Managed as one system.
Send a renewal, quote, equipment list or service challenge and see what is achievable

Name: Totient - Part of Absci
Description: Totient is an AI-driven biotechnology company leveraging tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) to identify novel tissue-specific antigens and develop matching high-affinity antibody therapeutics. Totient reconstructs antibodies from tissues affected by autoimmunity, infections, and cancer collected from patients experiencing exceptional immune responses. Beginning with a population of over 50,000 samples, we have reconstructed antibodies against known and novel extracellular oncology targets: GAGE1, GAGE2A, ANXA1, C4BPB, IL14A, BIRC7, HCLS1, GPR83, and others undisclosed.

Name: Istesso
Description:
Leading pharmaceutical tissue repair

We are all living longer but not necessarily living well. With an ageing population and almost all (90%) of us aged 45 years and older set to develop at least one chronic disease in our lifetime, the need for treatments that offer new solutions is essential.

At Istesso we are looking at chronic disease differently, focusing on repairing the damage caused by debilitating chronic conditions rather than symptom control. We are leading the field of tissue repair research, a currently untapped area that has the potential to fundamentally change the treatment paradigm for chronic disease and significantly improve patients’ lives. Our unique investigational treatments that repair, rebuild and restore damaged tissue, harness the body’s natural adaptive repair mechanisms, offering people the possibility of living disease free.

We believe in a future where chronic diseases can be healed, not just managed, and where the possibility of a disease-free life becomes a reality. Our ambitious, repair-first approach places the body’s innate repair mechanisms at the heart of our approach. We are unapologetic and unafraid to challenge conventional thinking as we execute on our mission to reshape the future by moving us from disease management to disease resolution.

Name: NeuroHarmonics
Description:
We're developing a category defining neurotech platform that uses next-generation ultrasound technology to non-invasively treat and interface with the brain. Our approach uses precisely focused sound waves to safely modulate specific brain circuits, establishing a new paradigm for non-invasive brain-computer interaction and therapeutic intervention. Transcranial ultrasound technology shows remarkable promise, not only for treating neurological and psychiatric conditions but also as a foundation for next-generation neuromodulation applications.

Our founding team combines expertise in ultrasound engineering and clinical neuroscience from world-leading institutions in medical technology and brain science. We're combining cutting-edge engineering with deep neuroscientific understanding to build what could become the gold standard for non-invasive neuromodulation, potentially transforming the lives of millions affected by brain disorders while opening new frontiers in brain-computer interaction.

Description: The European Bank for induced pluripotent Stem Cells (EBiSC) is a centralised, not-for-profit iPSC bank providing researchers across academia and industry with access to scalable, cost-efficient and consistent, high quality tools for new medicines development.

Name: Kyomei
Description:
Kyomei is a biotechnology company transforming wasted crop leaves into nature's bio-factories, creating and extracting healthy ingredients for 'clean label', better-for-you foods. We prioritize ingredients that are difficult to get at scale naturally, animal-derived, or increasingly unsustainable, providing the food industry with a scalable supply that meets growing demand. 

We not only address supply chain challenges for food manufacturers and consumers but also support farmers who face mounting economic and sustainability challenges, adding value to their existing crops without additional pressure on land use. 

Our vision is to improve existing agricultural systems rather than create entirely new ones. We work closely with farming communities to maximise the value of biomass that is otherwise wasted, shifting from a “one seed, one product” model to a “one seed, multiple products” model.

Together, we are building a healthier and more resilient food system by unlocking the potential of existing crops and leaves.

Name: Equilibrium Labs
Description:
The Equilibrium Labs Group is a Medtech company with a vision to advance awareness of the liver. 

As leading experts in the field of liver heath, they are on a journey to increase awareness surrounding this all-important organ, using science and research to help support and further develop their proposition.

The Equilibrium Labs Group own two other subsidiary companies supporting product development (de-liver-ance) and revolutionary services (The Liver Clinic).

Name: Celixir
Description:
Celixir (formerly known as Cell Therapy Ltd.) is a private British regenerative medicine company that discovers and develops life-saving and life-altering regenerative medicines for patients with the greatest medical need. 

Celixir, founded in 2009, is made up of a world-class team of scientists and biopharmaceutical executives, led by Nobel Laureate Professor Sir Martin Evans and former Roche Global Head of Emerging Technologies, Ajan Reginald. 

Celixir’s unique platform technology allows us to adopt an ‘off-the-shelf’ approach to deliver regenerative medicines to patients.

Name: Longevity Leaders
Description:
Longevity science is at a critical moment in time. In the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic investors, regulators and the medical community have woken up to the promise of ageing science and its potential to completely change how we prevent and treat disease. Advanced analytical tools are driving huge strides in our understanding of ageing biology and potential targets, and a number of high-profile fund raises are driving investor interest in the space.

Meanwhile, regenerative medicine goes from strength to strength, with the success of autologous stem cell treatments and renewed interest from the aesthetics industry. Gene therapies continue to show promise and inch closer to adoption. This is an incredibly exciting time to be a part of the growing longevity community.

Regenerative medicine and longevity therapeutics have both come a long way in recent years and set for the next decade of innovation, particularly with both gaining from parallel advancements in ageing science. The deeper understanding in cellular senescence, identification of aging genes, tissue engineering constructs and advancements in RNA modulation are all allowing longevity science and cell & gene therapies space to learn and innovate together.

The Longevity Leaders World Congress brings the world’s most prominent longevity scientists together, presenting the new research, responsible drug development and commercialisation. We’d love you to join us!

Name: Singer Instruments
Description:
Singer Instruments builds laboratory automation workstations for microbiologists, accelerating biological research through high-throughput colony picking and screening to custom automation for specialist workflows.

Our systems are used by thousands of research institutions across 60+ countries, including MIT, Stanford, NASA, Google, and Ginkgo Bioworks, supporting work across genetics, synthetic biology, antimicrobial resistance, and cancer biology.

Founded in 1934 and headquartered in Somerset, England, we design and manufacture everything in-house. This gives us complete control over quality, reliability, and performance, with no outsourcing and no shortcuts.

We are employee-owned, so the people building our systems have a direct stake in every instrument we ship. That shows up in the detail.

If you are looking to scale microbiology workflows, develop custom lab automation, or implement high-throughput screening, we would love to hear from you.

We are driven by a simple belief: biology holds the key to a healthier, cleaner, greener planet. Our role is to build the tools that help scientists get there faster.

Name: InSysBio
Description:
InSysBio is a Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) company established in 2004. Our team has been providing customers with QSP modeling services and tools for more than 10 years. We continuously develop our own QSP platforms and software infrastructure. We assist in making right decisions at critical stages of drug development. 

Our approach is based on our own cutting-edge methods and software. It enables us to reconstruct the effects of taking medication in terms of clinically measured biomarkers and end-points, predict the efficacy of a drug in humans on the basis of data obtained in animals and in vitro studies, search for optimal combinational therapies, and more. 

InSysBio has successfully completed more than 100 projects in collaboration with leaders of pharmaceutical industry. Moreover, InSysBio team provides educational assistance to academic entities.

To learn more about InSysBio, its solutions, services and tools, visit www.insysbio.com

Name: MultiplAI Health
Description:
MultiplAI Health is a preventive medicine company pioneering blood screening for cardiovascular and other complex diseases. Powered by genomic RNAseq, proprietary data transformation, and comprehensive AI analysis, our test transforms a single blood sample into a precision, actionable risk assessment to drive proactive health management that will extend lifespan.

We have a laboratory-validated prototype and are conducting our sixth clinical study to achieve technical validation of our whole-blood liquid biopsy approach in the cardiovascular space.

Name: Genesis Biosciences
Description:
We are Genesis Biosciences - a global biosciences company, based in both Atlanta, US, and Cardiff, UK. We have the unique capability to ferment bacteria strains and develop safe and natural microbial and antimicrobial products on a solid foundation of eco-benign technology. 

Using a combination of these technologies, we create environmentally-responsible products and solutions with a wide range of applications to meet our customers’ needs. 

Our manufacturing and laboratory facilities, strategically based in both the United States and Europe, enable us to provide unrivaled global technical support for our customers.

Name: SpyBiotech
Description:
Spun out of the University of Oxford in 2017, SpyBiotech is a clinically validated vaccine company built on proprietary protein "superglue" technology. It snaps antigens onto a vaccine scaffold in a single step, giving us a faster, more reliable way to build robust vaccines.

We apply this across two complementary platforms. Our virus-like particle (VLP) platform is Phase I-validated, and our viral vector platform extends the same plug-and-play approach to more targets. Together they form a flexible engine for vaccines against established and emerging diseases.

Two lead programmes drive our pipeline, both against major viral threats.. Our CMV candidate is Phase II ready, having reached Phase I proof of concept, and targets a leading infectious cause of birth defects. Our EBV candidate is Phase I ready, targeting a near-universal virus linked to certain cancers and multiple sclerosis.

Name: Russell IPM
Description: Russell IPM is a leading manufacturer of insect-pheromone based monitoring and control products for use in the agricultural, public health and pest control Industry. *Epigenetic tools
*Ion channel modulators

Based at Alderley Park in the North West of England, our work addresses unmet patient needs and will bring new portfolio of drugs into clinical trials to treat patients suffering from life-threatening infections.

Name: TCS Biosciences Ltd

From our facilities in rural North Buckinghamshire, TCS specialises in the manufacture and distribution of reagents, quality control products and test kits for use in the clinical, food, water and pharmaceutical sectors.

Microbiology 	Histopathology 
Haematology	Serology

Immunology		Cell Culture

Name: Elasmogen Ltd
Description: Elasmogen is a therapeutic biologics company developing dual targeting products for difficult-to-treat immune-mediated diseases. Our lead, first-in-class product, ELN28, is designed to target to the site of inflammation where it neutralises soluble TNFa whilst specifically and safely delivering Janus kinase inhibitor. Our mission is to clinically advance ELN28, positioning it as a truly transformative therapy for Hidradenitis Suppurativa.

We design innovative drugs with differentiated modes of action against cancer and other challenging diseases with high unmet medical need seeking superior patient outcomes.

Based on the unique integration of our dual core competences in aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase enzymes and distinctive AI/ML methods, our pipeline expansion is focused on oncology. This distinctive drug discovery platform has been validated by the rapid discovery of novel therapeutic candidates with highly innovative chemical scaffolds and modes of action.

Name: Altheome
Description:
Altheome is a biomarker and proteomics specialist advancing precision medicine through cutting-edge analytical platforms. With expertise in ultrasensitive immunoassays and next-generation proteomics, Altheome delivers unmatched sensitivity and scale in biomarker measurement. We partner with pharma, biotech, and academia to accelerate discovery, validate biomarkers, and translate insights into clinical impact. By bridging discovery and application, Altheome is shaping the future of biomarker-driven diagnostics and therapies.

From concept, to insight, to impact.

The era of biomarker-driven medicine is here, and Altheome is at its forefront, helping research move faster and smarter.

We can't wait to work with you.

Description:
XCellR8 is a world leader in non-animal testing.

Our GLP accredited laboratory provides ground-breaking in vitro safety and efficacy tests for the cosmetics and chemical industries.

We combine established regulatory tests with the development of exciting new methods, driven by our passionate commitment to provide you with rapid delivery of entirely animal-free testing strategies that are both scientifically advanced and ethically sound. Name: Cellcraft
Description:
Cellcraft is a Cambridge-based, B2B, AI-native start-up building the AI & Automation systems to unlock and power Bio-Manufacturing, which includes biopharma (including vaccines), precision fermentation, cultivated meat, cell and gene therapies, etc.

Our first product, Cellcraft IQ, is the world's 1st AI Plug-and-Play Operating System for Bio-Manufacturing. This AI-native bioprocess automation and optimisation software turns any bioreactor into an intelligent, self-optimising systems.

Cellcraft IQ can reduce inefficiency, costs and failure rates, whilst address key industry bottlenecks: the lack of real-time insight and adaptive optimisation in bio-manufacturing. 

Cellcraft IQ can transform how we produce food, medicine, and materials sustainably. Cellcraft's mission is to tackle some of the world's most pressing challenges using AI and Bio-Engineering.

Name: Phycobloom
Description: Phycobloom is developing the next generation of algae for the future world.

Name: Evoralis
Description:
Evoralis is an early-stage spin-out from the University of Cambridge with the mission to enable true and sustainable plastic recycling. It uses a unique ultrahigh-throughput screening platform to find and improve enzymes that can break down plastics into their constituent building-blocks to be re-used again within new products. 

At Evoralis, biocatalysts can be tested at unprecedented speed, making the discovery of plastic-degrading enzymes up to 1,000 times faster than any other current state-of-the-art approach. The high sensitivity of the screening platform used by Evoralis allows the selection of the most interesting and efficient candidates.

Our journey is just at the beginning, feel welcome to contact us if you are interested in contributing to a circular plastic economy.

Name: ACX
Description:
ACX is developing a new standard for precision agriculture technologies by providing sustainable, eco-friendly alternatives to chemical pesticides. Our mission is to transform agriculture through sustainable biological crop protection that increases yields while safeguarding the environment, farmers and consumers.

Connect With Us:
We welcome inquiries from individuals interested in our work, especially biochemists, biophysicists and software engineers with expertise in protein/genetic engineering, molecular biology, or ML. If that’s you or someone you know, don’t hesitate to reach out.

Name: Kuano
Description:
Kuano is applying advanced computational methods to solve the hardest problems in therapeutic design, accelerating the path to life-changing medicines.

Look at our evidence here: https://www.kuano.ai

At the core of our offering is the Quantum Lens technology, a proprietary platform combining cutting-edge quantum physics with other high-end in silico techniques. Our technology is redefining how the industry understands complex binding and reactivity, enabling the exploration of molecular interactions beyond simplified views, incorporating quantum chemistry, AI, and system dynamics to achieve unparalleled precision.

Our rigorous quantum-informed simulations blended with sophisticated AI-assisted workflows, are deployed by an expert team of physicists and drug hunters, working collaboratively with our partners to decipher complex modes of binding and explore completely untapped areas of chemical space. Whether the problem is selectivity, potency, novelty or unlocking something ‘undruggable’, we help partners design novel inhibitors with confidence, precision, and deeper scientific insight. 

Kuano’s unique platform can address many target types and modalities, from classical enzyme inhibitors to allosteric binders, and including covalent ligand reactivity prediction, moving beyond traditional limitations to analyze reactivity across different amino acid residues considering the full biological context. This results in Quantum Fingerprints that capture subtle electronic and energetic features missed by conventional analysis.

Founded on the belief that next-generation computation is key to solving disease, Kuano works closely with a broad range of organisations, including leading global pharmaceutical and biotech organisations. We are committed to developing new products and researching novel technologies to dramatically improve the efficiency and productivity of the drug discovery process for our clients.

Name: Tessellate Bio
Description:
Tessellate BIO discovers and develops novel precision oncology medicines with the mission to turn cancer patients into cancer survivors. 

A private preclinical stage biotechnology company, Tessellate BIO is redefining Synthetic Lethality by developing drugs that target unexplored or difficult to drug pathways beyond HRD. 

Headquartered in the Netherlands and with research labs at the Stevenage Bioscience Catalyst, UK, Tessellate BIO is supported by top-tier life science investors BioGeneration Ventures (BGV) and Forbion.

Name: Biosceptre International Limited
Description: Biosceptre is developing a multi-targeted universal CAR-T system, designed to incorporate our nfP2X7 technology, to be capable of treating a range of cancers.

Name: 3D Bio-Tissues ltd - powered by BSF plc
Description:
3D Bio-tissues (3DBT) is a biotechnology company redefining the efficiency of cell-based therapies and cellular agriculture. We specialize in the development of macromolecular crowders—simple, powerful media additives designed to mimic the natural physiological environment, accelerating growth and significantly reducing operational costs.
At the core of our innovation is a commitment to making complex biology scalable. By optimizing the way cells interact with their environment, we help our partners move from lab-scale success to industrial-scale reality.
Our Core Solutions:
CityMixTM | Transforming Cultivated Meat:
The biggest barrier to cultivated meat is the cost of media. CityMixTM is a patented macromolecular crowder that reduces the requirement for expensive growth factors and supplements. It enables higher yields and faster production times, making sustainable, slaughter-free meat commercially viable.
CytoBoostTM | Powering Biopharmaceutical Science:
Precision matters in bioprocessing. CytoBoostTM enhances the performance of cell lines used in drug discovery and therapeutic production. It stabilizes proteins and improves cellular productivity without complex media reformulations.
CytoBoostTM REVIVE | The Post-Thaw Cell Enabler:
Cryopreservation is a critical stressor for cells. CytoBoostTM REVIVE is specifically formulated to act as a post-thaw enabler, minimizing the "lag phase" and maximizing cell viability and recovery. It ensures that your research or production starts with the strongest biological foundation possible.
Why 3DBT?
We don’t just provide additives; we provide the tools for the next generation of life sciences. Whether you are aiming to lower the price of a cultivated steak or increase the yield of a life-saving biologic, our macromolecular crowding technology is the "plug-and-play" solution your bioprocess needs.
Location: Newcastle upon Tyne, England, United Kingdom

Name: 2BScientific Ltd.
Description:
2BScientific is a leading distributor of innovative life science products, serving customers in the UK, Europe, and worldwide. 

Our top priority is always the customer, and we go above and beyond to provide exceptional service and innovative products that support scientific discovery. 

From cutting-edge assays and technologies to reagents for basic research, we offer a wide range of innovative products that are designed to meet the needs of researchers across a variety of disciplines.

Name: NeuroX
Description:
NeuroX is building Neve: the nervous system intelligence layer for human performance.

Using EEG, HRV, and AI, Neve measures cognitive state, stress, and recovery, delivering a daily Readiness Score for better decisions, earlier fatigue detection, and sustained peak performance.

Starting in elite sport, expanding into high-performance teams.

Name: Industrial Biotechnology Innovation Catalyst
Description: The Industrial Biotechnology Innovation Catalyst (IBIC) is a £5 million EPSRC place-based initiative that brings together north-west England's industrial biotechnology community to accelerate knowledge exchange, skills development, and innovation. It will galvanise links between the region's science, research, innovation, and teaching sectors to create real-world impact.

Name: Cell Guidance Systems
Description:
Cell Guidance Systems develops specialist reagents and services for life science research, with particular expertise in extracellular vesicle biology, sustained-release growth factor delivery and cytogenetics.
Our EV portfolio includes Exo-spin SEC isolation kits, EVlution TFF systems, ExoLISA biomarker assays and a full outsourced EV isolation and MISEV-compliant characterisation service including NTA, western blot and freeze drying.

Our cytogenetics service provides professional karyotype analysis and AGH testing for academic and commercial laboratories.
Based at Babraham Bioscience Campus, Cambridge UK, with offices in St. Louis, USA.

Name: Samsara Therapeutics
Description: At Samsara Therapeutics, we’re on a mission to unlock the full potential of autophagy activation in combating age-related neurodegenerative diseases. Our innovative approach aims to delay the progression of several debilitating conditions, offering new possibilities for patients and their families.

Description: We have created a proprietary Nucleic Acid Nanorobotics (NANs) platform that simplifies molecular testing and quantification for RNA therapeutics and biomarkers.

Name: Clyde Biosciences
Description:
Clyde Biosciences is the leading cardiac cell analysis solution provider, used by the biopharma industry to help bring better, safer drugs to market.  Our services are conducted on the CellOPTIQ platform, a unique technology designed to eliminate the risk of false positive or false negative results.

CellOPTIQ provides clients with unparalleled data at a time when the industry needs it most, offering greater data resolution than any other assay, doing so in one experiment.

With over 100 years of combined electrophysiology and computational experience Clyde Biosciences’ scientists work with pharmaceutical companies to design testing, data interpretation, and reporting packages that suit the efficacy and safety assessment objectives.

HOW WE WORK...

Upon completion of the laboratory work, a report will be produced commensurate with your objectives.

CiPA Assay (we are the only optical platform used in the major international CiPA Initiative)

Custom R&D

Name: Cambridge University Alt Protein Project
Description:
Building the Alternative Protein field in Cambridge and the UK. Bringing together students, academics and entrepreneurs to create a sustainable food future.
