Name: Amber Therapeutics
Description:
Amber Therapeutics was founded in 2021 with a mission to develop and deliver breakthrough neuromodulation therapies that can fundamentally transform outcomes in areas of unmet clinical need. With the acquisition of Finetech Medical Limited and Bioinduction Ltd in 2023, we are continuing to be the only UK based company in the field of designing and manufacturing long-term implantables. 
 
We have since grown into a multidisciplinary team, combining deep medical device experience with a culture and mindset focused on transformational innovation. 
 
Amber UI is the company’s first therapy, aiming to restore normal physiological function in women suffering with mixed urinary incontinence.

Name: Nonacus
Description: Nonacus is a leading provider of genetic testing products headquartered in Birmingham, UK. Collaborating closely with scientists and clinicians, the company is developing a comprehensive precision oncology workflow including support for primary tumor and liquid biopsy analysis with the ultimate goal of creating a world where early cancer diagnosis, detection and management is simple and universally available.

Name: Tebubio
Description:
We facilitate Life Sciences Research every day, contributing to advance Science for a brighter future. Through our local offices located across Europe, we support Life Sciences and Biotechnology Researchers with a unique, holistic range of solutions to advance their projects faster:

- We enable researchers to be at the forefront in their Research with access to cutting-edge biological solutions sourced from reputed global Life Sciences suppliers, carefully selected by our Scientific Team for their relevance and evaluated for their ethical and legal compliance. 

- We accelerate their Research thanks to our Contract Research Services’ strong expertise in mRNA production & delivery, cell line engineering & protein production, cellular studies and biomarkers analysis when they lack time, routine practice or expertise.

- We streamline their ordering process thanks to our e-procurement solutions, enable them to benefit from our many years of supply chain experience in handling biological solutions, save significant time and avoid administrative complexity as they can rely on the permits and certifications we hold.

With Tebubio, concentrate your efforts and accelerate what’s most important to you: Your Research.

Name: Metrion Biosciences
Description:
Metrion is a specialist preclinical drug discovery CRO with deep expertise in ion channel screening, including high-throughput assays. We also offer translational cardiac safety studies and neuroscience assays using DRG and other primary neurons. Our customers value the high-quality data, scientific insight, and collaborative approach that enable us to interpret results, provide tailored recommendations, and act as an extension of their research team.

Metrion’s leadership team brings over 125 years of combined drug discovery experience, with 100 years focused on ion channels. This expertise, cited in around 150 publications, underpins our reputation for delivering world-class screening and discovery services. Our senior scientists and executives draw on backgrounds in pharmaceutical R&D, biotech, and CRO operations to shape strategy, drive innovation, and ensure quality outcomes for our partners.

Name: Serna Bio
Description:
An estimated 85% of the ~3 billion base pairs in the human genome is transcribed into RNA, but only ~1.5% of these code for proteins. 

While the chemical properties of protein binders are increasingly understood and interrogated, the field of RNA-targeted drugs is relatively new and the properties of small molecules that drive specific and selective targeting of RNA, and associated assays, are yet to be developed. 

At Serna Bio [previously Ladder Therapeutics] we are using an AI enabled, data-first approach to write the rules that define RNA-small molecule interactions. Our Discovery Platform powers our first-in-class small molecule programs targeted at classically undruggable proteins and non-coding RNA targets, targeting both human and non-human biology.

Name: TMC Pharma Services Ltd
Description:
TMC is a global pharma services company, partnering with small to mid-sized biotech and pharma companies to accelerate drug development timelines and maximise value across the full product lifecycle.  

We provide end-to-end support - from early stage clinical development to clinical execution, market access and drug commercialisation. Our integrated pharma services are delivered by cross-functional experts with extensive knowledge across regulatory, clinical development, medical services, pharmacovigilance and quality specialities.

Whether you're advancing a rare disease treatment, pioneering an advanced therapeutic modality or preparing for market entry in the EU and UK, TMC is the pharma services company with the agility, insight and infrastructure to make it happen.

Name: PCR Biosystems
Description:
PCR Biosystems is a leading developer of PCR reagents for molecular biology research and diagnostics. We offer a wide range of solutions including lyophilisable and air-dryable reagents, high-concentration polymerases, thermostable reverse transcriptases and proprietary hot start technologies to maximise yield and sensitivity from the simplest to most challenging of reactions. 

Founded in 2012, in the UK, by two PCR experts, we believe scientists deserve better performance and value from their PCR reagents. The service we provide really matters to us too. Alongside standard and custom solutions we offer free samples, bulk supply, OEM manufacturing and tailored technical support to help you achieve the most from our market-leading reagents. 

In addition, we’re an ISO-13485 certified company, meaning customers can have the assurance that the products we develop meet the design and manufacturing standards for medical device components.

Name: Materiom
Description:
Materiom’s mission is to accelerate the discovery of breakthrough bio-based materials. 

Imagine a world where plastic is plant food. A world where packaging can fertilize nutrient-starved soils and help drawdown carbon. If it lands up in the ocean, it degrades into food for fish. Rather than another piece of pollution, it is a bundle of nutrients. 

Earth’s most abundant macromolecules—renewable, biomass-derived building blocks—offer a vast, under-explored frontier for materials science. We build knowledge and AI-enabled tools for everyone working on the transition — from early-stage researchers to leading organizations.

Name: Ignota Labs
Description:
More than half of all clinical trials fail due to safety issues. Discovering drugs that show therapeutic potential is difficult, time-consuming, and expensive. But of those found, it is harder still to find those drugs which do not also have severe side effects and can pass through clinical trials. 

Most of these drugs are shelved  and never reach patients. Safety issues are tough to fix without weakening the therapeutic effect, involving a mix of chemistry, biology, and knowledge of how humans will respond. 

Our proprietary AI model, SAFEPATH, applies deep learning to our combined bioinformatics and cheminformatics datasets to solve drug safety issues. SAFEPATH utilises the latest deep learning approaches to identify the mechanism of toxicity, predict its effects on the human body, and balance that with therapeutic effectiveness.

We are building at speed a robust pipeline of matured assets. We look at historically failed clinical trials to identify the most promising targets as well as internal projects that were abandoned. By focusing on safety problems that occur in Preclinical, Phase 1, or Phase 2 trials, we are able to identify the most promising drugs therapeutically, turn them around quickly, and get them to patients faster than starting drug discovery from scratch.

Our mission is to bring more treatments to patients, faster. Thousands of life-changing drugs fall at the last hurdle and never reach patients. We’re here to change that.

Name: Roslin Technologies
Description:
Based outside Edinburgh, Roslin Technologies Limited is an ambitious food and agriculture technology company which creates disruptive biotechnologies to improve how proteins are made. 
 
Our core capabilities lie in developing and commercialising a suite of unique animal stem cells and resources for the nascent global cultivated meat industry.  
 
We were the first company to commercialise pluripotent stem cells which continually self-renew and are able differentiate into the fat and muscle tissue required in the cultivated meat industry. In addition, we are now focussing our R&D on addressing key challenges in the sector including production cost reduction and process scale-up.

We have developed unique animal cells that work; our cells can self-renew forever and differentiate into any tissue, including muscle and fat. Our cells are favourable for cultivated meat production since they address consumer concerns, make meat more affordable, and simplify regulatory approvals.

Besides cells for cultivated meat, we continue to look for other biotechnologies that help us make protein production more sustainable.

Name: National Biofilms Innovation Centre
Description: The National Biofilms Innovation Centre (NBIC) is an Innovation and Knowledge Centre funded by BBSRC and Innovate UK. NBIC was launched in 2017 by its four lead Universities (Edinburgh, Liverpool, Nottingham and Southampton) and is led by four Co-Directors: Professors Cait MacPhee, Rasmita Raval, Kim Hardie and Jeremy Webb respectively and CEO Jo Slater-Jefferies. With a consortium of 72 academic partner institutions across the UK, NBIC is the central hub where academia, industry, government and public policy come together to tackle the grand challenges biofilms present, impacting $5 trillion per annum in global economic activity - from food and health to ships, clean water and energy.

Name: Lightcast
Description: Lightcast is developing a novel, droplet-based platform that provides a deeper understanding of cellular function. Compared to standard microfluidic methods, the Lightcast platform offers the ability to run a broader range of assays and to precisely control and track the number, occupancy, location, and movement of each droplet. The unprecedented scalability and flexibility of this approach will help advance translational and basic research as well as streamline development workflows for drugs, therapeutics, and applied biologics.

Name: Cathay Biotech Inc.
Description:
Founded in 2000, Cathay Biotech Inc. is a globally leading biotechnology company. Focusing on integrated polyamide industrial chain, Cathay Biotech utilizes bio-manufacturing technology to realize research, development, production, and sales of innovative materials. Cathay Biotech has a range of large-scale industrialized biotechnologies, including bio-converted long-chain dicarboxylic acids, bio-based 1,5-pentanediamine, and bio-based polyamide.

Distinguished by "renewable, recyclable, and cost-effective" properties, Cathay Biotech's products find applications across diverse industries, such as automotive, electronic & electrical (E&E), smartphone, apparel, textile, etc. Currently, Cathay Biotech is developing technologies for fiber-reinforced bio-based polyamide composites, aiming to provide lightweight, eco-friendly solutions for sectors including alternative energy, green building, logistics, oil and gas pipes etc.

In the future, Cathay Biotech will continue to advance the development of green monomers and high-performance green biomaterials to meet the growing market demand for low-carbon products. Cathay Biotech is committed to adopting clean energy and advancing its technology to build an integrated green industrial chain. By prioritizing the balance between environmental stewardship, societal impact, and corporate governance, Cathay aims to establish itself as a leader in sustainable biomaterial development.

Name: Biorelate
Description: Biorelate helps scientists solving the most difficult biomedical challenges of today. We do this by providing the most novel knowledge graph in biopharma for better knowledge review, target and biomarker discovery, mechanism of action understanding, and indication expansion.

Name: Markes
Description:
Markes, a Velaris brand, is a world-leading developer of technologies that enhance the analytical power of GC for both routine & research work. Its award-winning thermal desorption & automated sample extraction/concentration systems enable highly sensitive trace-level analysis of volatile & semi-volatile organic compounds across gases, liquids & solids. These capabilities are complemented by its subsidiary, SepSolve, which supplies advanced GC and GC×GC platforms, TOF MS & specialist software for data mining, chemometrics & chromatogram comparison.
 
Together, Markes and SepSolve deliver integrated workflows from sampling to confident data interpretation, supporting laboratories working in environmental monitoring, materials testing, food/beverage analysis, flavour and fragrance chemistry & clinical research.

Name: Eurofins Food & Water Testing UK & IE
Description:
Eurofins Food & Water Testing UK provides accredited, science‐driven testing services that help organisations meet stringent quality, safety and regulatory requirements. With UK‐wide laboratories supported by Eurofins’ global network and centres of excellence, we provide accurate results, specialist expertise and practical support across the full food and water supply chain.

Food Testing Services
- Microbiology: Pathogens, indicator organisms and hygiene monitoring.
- Allergens: Accredited testing across food products, swabs and rinse waters.
- Contaminants & Residues: Pesticides, mycotoxins, heavy metals, acrylamide, POPs, PAHs, PFAS, veterinary drugs and more.
- Nutrition & Composition: Full nutritional profiling for labelling, NPD and compliance.
- Authenticity & Origin: Species identification, isotopic analysis and fraud detection.
- Advanced Chemistry: Vitamins, minerals, inorganics, CBD, GMO and speciation testing.

Water Hygiene Testing
- Microbiology: Legionella, TVCs, coliforms, E. coli, Pseudomonas, yeasts and moulds.
- Chemistry: Metals, inorganics, organics and PFAS analysis.
- Healthcare & Compliance: Testing aligned with HTM, LCA and national guidance.
- Secure Logistics: Nationwide refrigerated courier and drop‐off network.

How We Support You
We combine robust analytical science with consultancy, risk management, data insights and digital tools such as Europortal to provide reliable evidence, clear reporting and actionable insight.

Eurofins Food & Water Testing UK — trusted science, reliable service and technical expertise that support compliance and protect consumer confidence.

Name: EyeBio
Description: EyeBio is a privately held ophthalmology biotechnology company dedicated to developing and delivering a new generation of therapies to protect, restore, and improve vision in patients with sight-threatening eye diseases.

Name: Fusion Antibodies
Description:
Since 2001, Fusion Antibodies has been dedicated to the discovery and early development of antibodies to help bring about a positive change in the healthcare industry.
We offer a complete range of antibody-related services in Discovery, Engineering and Supply and have guided hundreds of projects through critical preclinical stages.
Fifteen of our client’s projects have advanced to clinical stages, some as far as Phase II.

We deliver a superior service for the development of antibodies by beginning each project with the end in mind. Our scientists are experts in early stage discovery of biologics.

We offer this personalised service because we know that investment at the early stages saves not only millions of dollars but also months, even years of time, on projects that go awry at later stages of development. 

Through our vast experience we have developed a number of our own proprietary platforms for Antibody Humanization (CRXTM), Affinity Maturation (RAMPTM) and Developability optimisation (ADDTM). 

Fusion Antibodies is a publicly held company, trading on the London Stock Exchange (LSE FAB.L) with headquarters in Belfast, Northern Ireland.

Name: BIOS Health Ltd
Description:
BIOS Health uses AI-driven insights from the nervous system to build neural digital therapies - the next big trend in precision medicines. The human nervous system carries vast quantities of data, and BIOS’ ability to precisely link nerve activity to specific conditions through the discovery of their neural biomarkers is a game changer for precision medicine. BIOS’ research could hold the key to new treatments for conditions including hypertension, diabetes, rheumatoid arthritis, and even diseases of the brain itself such as Parkinson’s or Alzheimer’s. BIOS is positioned to provide the neural code on which a new generation of treatments can be built that can enable millions of people suffering from chronic diseases to improve their quality of life.

Co-founded by Cambridge University researchers Emil Hewage, a computational neuroscientist, and Oliver Armitage, a biomechanical engineer, BIOS is made up of a wide range of experts from neuroscience, machine learning, software engineering, applied biomaterials, biotechnology, medicine, and business and operations. The combined experience of the BIOS team extends to over 300 peer-reviewed publications, 10+ first of kind medical devices, and 6k+ clinical procedures.

We are looking for people who will fit into our diverse, fun and stimulating company team culture, who are focused on overcoming challenges, and want to grow along with the company. We are especially looking for candidates that share our values: enjoy solving hard problems; bring a unique perspective but become an active part of the BIOS team; respect what matters and do what’s right; and enjoy the challenge.

We’re building a dynamic team of people across our offices in Cambridge, UK and Boston, MA; all united by our shared ambition, enthusiasm, and creativity.

Name: SpeeDx Pty Ltd
Description: Founded in 2009, SpeeDx is an Australian-based private company with offices in London and the US, and distributors across Europe. SpeeDx specializes in molecular diagnostic solutions that go beyond simple detection to offer comprehensive information for improved patient management. Innovative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) technology has driven market-leading multiplex detection and priming strategies. Product portfolios focus on multiplex diagnostics for sexually transmitted infection (STI), antibiotic resistance markers, and respiratory disease.

Name: Inivata
Description:
Inivata is a leader in liquid biopsy. Its InVision platform unlocks essential genomic information from a simple blood test to transform the care of cancer patients. The Company’s technology is based on pioneering research from the Cancer Research UK Cambridge Institute, University of Cambridge and backed by multiple high calibre publications. Its lead product, InVisionFirstTM-Lung, is commercially available and provides molecular insights that enable clinicians to make more informed treatment decisions for NSCLC patients. Inivata is partnering with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies on InVisionFirst-Lung and its wider platform, which is applicable to a range of cancer types. The Company has a CLIA laboratory in Research Triangle Park, NC and R&D laboratories in Cambridge, UK. For more information, please go to www.inivata.com. Follow us on Twitter @Inivata.



For more information, please go to www.inivata.com. Follow us on Twitter @Inivata.

Description:

Our mission is simply captured by three words – making algae work.

We are delivering this mission through algae-based solutions and innovations that satisfy global priority areas, while respecting sustainability and delivering positive impact.

Name: Ottimo Pharma
Description: Ottimo Pharma is a private biotechnology company, co-founded in 2020 by Medicxi and Jonny Finlay, focused on the development of pioneering innovative cancer therapies for solid tumors. The Company's lead program, Jankistomig, is a PD1-VEGFR2 bi-functional antibody designed to target both immune checkpoint inhibition and angiogenesis in a single IgG therapy. By advancing this dual-pathway approach, Ottimo Pharma aims to improve cancer treatment outcomes and reduce overall healthcare burden. The Company boasts a world-class leadership team, including David Epstein as Chair and CEO, Mehdi Shahidi as Head of Development and CMO, and James Sabry as Vice-Chair of the Board. Name: BioDot, Inc
Description:
A Global Leader in Precision Liquid Dispensing for Over 30 Years

BioDot, a division of ATS Automation’s Life Sciences Division, is a market leader in liquid dispensing technologies, specializing in picoliter, nanoliter, and microliter volumes. Name: ARC Regulatory
Description:
ARC's purpose is to expedite access to precision medicine clinical trials for patients globally.  We fulfil our purpose through our dedicated team of experts with unparalleled domain knowledge, and the important relationships we have developed with our global clients.

Name: Mereo BioPharma
Description:
Welcome to Mereo BioPharma, we are an agile biopharmaceutical company, focused on finding and bringing to market therapies that will improve the lives of people living with a rare disease.
We are driven by a true understanding of the critical nature of our mission.  We harness the power of science; with our knowledge of the rare diseases we seek to treat and deep relationships with all our stakeholders to create new therapeutic possibilities for people who need them. We do this in a focused and capital efficient manner.
Our journey began back in March 2015 fuelled by the desire to champion high-potential novel therapies that were not being progressed in pharmaceutical or biotechnology companies.  We acquired three product candidates from Novartis in 2015 and one from AstraZeneca in 2017. Merging with OncoMed in 2019 strengthened our foundation, broadening our reach and adding cutting-edge oncology programs to our pipeline.
The Mereo team is a crew on a mission. We understand the gravity of our work for people with few therapeutic options.  Mereo’s agile approach is enabling us to move rigorously but quickly through trial programs. We have taken two therapies from in-licensing to pharma through to Phase 3 studies in under 5 years. Our portfolio covers potential therapies addressing critical needs in Osteogenesis Imperfecta (OI), Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency-associated Lung Disease (AATD-LD) and two oncology product candidates.
Our entrepreneurial spirit and purpose-led approach attracts the most talented people from across pharma and biotech. Every single team member is here because of their passion for helping people with health conditions, and their unique skills, experience and perspectives. We know what it takes to navigate reimbursement, which can be complex and have the expertise to drive excellence.
Follow our updates on this extraordinary journey as we continue to collaborate with our stakeholders to forge new ways of doing things in rare disease.

Description: Broken String Bioscience’s technology platform, INDUCE-seq, supports the development of cell and gene therapies that are safer by design. Description:
CLINUVEL PHARMACEUTICALS LTD (ASX: CUV; NASDAQ: CUVL; XETRA-DAX: UR9) is a global and diversified biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercialising treatments for patients with genetic, metabolic, and life-threatening disorders, as well as healthcare solutions for the general population. As pioneers in photomedicine and understanding the interaction of light and human biology, CLINUVEL’s research and development has led to innovative treatments for patient populations with a clinical need for systemic photoprotection, DNA repair and acute or life threatening conditions. These patient groups range in size from 5,000 to 45 million worldwide. CLINUVEL’s lead compound, SCENESSE (afamelanotide 16mg), was approved by the European Commission in 2014 and the US Food and Drug Administration in 2019 for the prevention of phototoxicity (anaphylactoid reactions and burns) in adult patients with erythropoietic protoporphyria (EPP). Name: Theolytics
Description:
Theolytics is an Oxford-based, clinical-stage biotechnology company developing differentiated intravenous oncolytic immunotherapies for solid tumours.

From library to life - breaking the barrier to solid tumours.

Solid tumours are difficult to treat with oncolytic viruses because most candidates cannot be delivered systemically, and because the tumour microenvironment (TME) suppresses the immune response needed for a durable effect. Our approach is built to address both problems.

Our proprietary Adenovo platform applies natural selection from the world's largest adenovirus library to identify candidates with novel biology. Rather than engineering a single virus and hoping it performs, we select for the behaviours that matter - including intravenous delivery and activity in immune-suppressed tumours - from diversity that already exists.

Lead candidate THEO-260 combines three therapeutic mechanisms in a single agent: killing cancer cells, killing cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs), and inducing anti-tumour immunity. It achieves this without transgene arming, and is in Phase 1 clinical development, with an initial focus on platinum-resistant ovarian cancer and potential application across stroma-rich solid tumours. THEO-260 is investigational and is not approved in any territory.

We work with clinical investigators, academic groups, and pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners who share our interest in reaching solid tumours systemically. If you are exploring oncolytic platforms, combination strategies, or partnering opportunities, we would welcome a conversation.

Our values guide how we work: Patient Focus, Collaborative, Deliver with Integrity, Innovative.

Based at ARC Oxford, United Kingdom.
Learn more: www.theolytics.com

Description:

AB Scientific; always bringing you the latest products and solutions.

We have developed a pipeline of ‘off-the-shelf’ vaccines which induce immune responses and highly tumour specific monoclonal antibodies that redirect immune cells or drugs. Our advanced therapeutic vaccine programmes, SCOPE and ModiFY, have shown promising efficacy in Phase 2 trials, demonstrating long-term survival in metastatic melanoma and a broad range of solid tumours.

Name: ACCSN | Afro - Caribbean Commercial Science Network
Description:
Our mission is to bring black and ethnic minority commercial and broader life science professionals together by supporting the development of current and aspiring professionals in the industry while providing a space through which we can thrive together. We also aim to break down the barriers by raising the profile of black and ethnic minorities in commercial science and make the sector a more attractive career destination. This will be achieved by providing opportunities, safe spaces, networking and mentorship. 

In addition, we will provide you with all the resources required to get your foot in the door.

Ever thought that the laboratory work is no longer for you? Thinking about making the transition from the lab to the commercial side but don't know how? or do you have a strong scientific background and want to venture into commercial science? We are are here to help!

Our Values

Educate – Equip current and aspiring professionals with the knowledge on the different career paths and skills required to progress in a career in commercial science. Ultimately leading a more diverse pipeline of talent in the commercial science sector.

Connect – Build a community of professionals in the industry to network, collaborate and form life-long networks  

Find talent – Attract more black and ethnic minority talent to a career in commercial and broader life science. This will include us creating access for young and aspiring professionals through mentorship, internships, and work experience

Name: MAGic-MOLFUN
Description:
The MAGic-MOLFUN doctoral network (DN) will train the next generation of specialists to transform natural products research. 

The next generation of specialists will be educated in a combination of wet-lab and computational skills to integrate genome mining and metabolomics with cutting-edge pathway discovery- and engineering approaches. There is a fast-growing demand for these combinations of skills, but these are rarely taught in current integrated training programs. These multidisciplinary skills and qualifications will be acquired while achieving the scientific goals of the program, namely understanding and developing the complex biosynthesis and production of microbial NPs for cross-sector applications such as medicine, food, agriculture, or biotechnology. Specifically, the Doctoral Candidates (DCs) will work in three areas:

    1) develop novel computational tools and algorithms to improve the identification and prediction quality of biosynthetic gene clusters encoding NP biosynthesis in genomic data. This genome-centered approach is complemented by
   2)  the use of cheminformatics approaches to link metabolomics data of NPs with the genomic data of the producers, which will greatly improve the compound discovery and dereplication process. These two data-centric approaches will finally
    3) converge into experimental applications that discover and characterize novel NPs with promising bioactivities (e.g., antibiotics, pre-/probiotics, agrichemicals, bio-pigments).

The scientific training program is complemented by a comprehensive transferable skill training that will equip the DCs for todays’ demands of a successful career in industry and academia. The skills obtained in the DN will enable the DCs to work not only in natural product research but also many other data-intensive areas of biotechnology.

“This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon Europe programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie grant agreement No 101072485”.

Description: NeRRe Therapeutics is developing orvepitant, a neurokinin (NK)-1 receptor antagonist, as a first in class, once daily breakthrough treatment for cough hypersensitivity disorders. Having demonstrated proof of efficacy in patients with refractory or unexplained cough, NeRRe will now continue development in chronic cough caused by the rare and terminal lung disease idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). A dominant feature of this severe progressive respiratory disease in a high proportion of patients is an uncontrolled and persistent cough which is disabling for these terminally ill patients. The cough is often refractory to medical therapy and there are no approved treatments. Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis has been designated an orphan disease in both Europe and the USA.

Name: ZYTCA Animal Health
Description: ZYTCA's mission is to revolutionise the industry with comprehensive diagnostic solutions for easier, faster, and affordable animal disease diagnosis, and to enhance both animal and human health through the One Health approach.

Name: Protein Stable
Description: Protein Stable, Leatherhead, UK, has been set up to solve the challenges of protein stability screening in a market where new large molecule therapeutic introductions have outpaced technology development.  By introducing the first fully microplate-based screening of native proteins, we have solved the issues of ease of sample handling through the process, higher throughputs with lower sample usage and virtually eliminated expensive consumables.  Used either stand-alone or as part of a broader automation strategy, stability screening has now caught up with the rest of the drug discovery pipeline. It can deliver fast, accurate answers to the most stable candidates in construct screening, formulation and lead optimisation.

Name: Activatec Ltd
Description:
Activatec develops technologies to produce biobased ingredients from renewable sources. We are specialised in the evaluation, scale-up and commercialisation of processes to produce biotechnological and plant-based ingredients and materials from currently unused and low-value organic sources.

Activatec is a B2B Partner that provides support to the industrial biotechnology sector in the form of research services on a contract basis. We are currently working within a number of international partner projects to design, develop and scale-up novel technologies for the production of emerging and high-value bio-based products.

Name: PBD Biotech
Description:
PBD Biotech develops Actiphage, a blood test that detects live Mycobacteria, the cause of tuberculosis (TB) in humans and bovine TB and Johne's Disease in animals. 

One quarter of the world’s population is infected with latent tuberculosis (LTBI), and for one in ten of these people it will progress to active TB disease. As Actiphage detects the presence of active infection, it has potential for a screening test for the disease and to improve drug management.

Mycobacteria also cause the diseases bovine TB and Johne's Disease in animals, and these are economically disasterous. Actiphage is available now to test for these diseases using a sample of blood or milk. Unlike most widely used diagnostics that depend on the animal's immune response, Actiphage detects the presence of the pathogen, providing a yes/no result before clinical symptoms are present.  Helping to break the cycle of infection.

Contact us to discuss testing. 

Leveraging Actiphage’s unique role in detecting active TB, PBD aims to drive innovation in the novel uses for TB screening and drug management.

Name: Trailfinder CF Innovation Hub
Description: CF-TRAILFINDER will serve people with cystic fibrosis at all life stages by developing new approaches to treating lung infections, managing exacerbations and maintaining healthy lungs.

Name: ScreenIn3D
Description: Accelerating drug candidate selection using human 3D models of disease at scale with microfluidic technology

Name: Abgent, a WuXi AppTec company
Description:
Abgent, a WuXi AppTec company, is a leading manufacturer of primary antibodies with more than a decade of experience. We meet the ever changing demands of research and drug discovery through a thoughtful target selection process and strengthened validation-standards. Moreover, we strive to continuously improve the customer experience through comprehensive technical support, a world class website, and an easy ordering process.

Company highlights:
• Most antibodies are produced in-house to ensure specificity, affinity, and reproducibility.
• Over 1,000 new antibodies are released per year with an emphasis on autophagy, stem cells, and neurodegeneration.
• Striving for proteome-wide antibody coverage.
• Featuring our “Crown” line of premium antibodies and offering evaluation size vials for more than 10,000 products.

In addition, Abgent offers the highest quality services including custom antibody development, custom peptide synthesis and custom protein expression. Synthesis of difficult peptides, including long peptides, is a core competency of Abgent. High quality, rapid turnaround and personal support for all Abgent services are guaranteed.

Browse our website or contact us directly in order to discover what Abgent can do for you. We are here to be your partner for scientific research and discovery.

Name: Kirkstall Ltd
Description: Kirkstall, a biotechnology company, is the creator of the Quasi Vivo system - an easy to use, commercially available interconnected flow system.

Name: Change Bio
Description:
At Change Bio we are building a protein production platform to speed up protein innovation in food, cosmetics, and materials. We support the protein discovery journey with the quick production of gram-scale samples, backed by a platform built to scale quickly.   

You pick the protein. We provide the process.

Drop us a line at hello@changebio.uk

Name: AB BIOTECHNOLOGY LIMITED
Description: AB BIOTECHNOLOGY LIMITED is a biotechnology company based out of Pentlands Science Park, Bush Loan, Penicuik, Midlothian, EH26 0PZ

Name: Pharmagene Discovery Services
Description:
We partner with biopharma and biotech innovators as a trusted CRO, uniting high-quality human biospecimens, advanced translational models, and deep scientific expertise to deliver tailored, insight-driven data that de-risks drug development, accelerates programmes and helps advance human health.
With our focus on translational research using human tissue and cellular models, we’ve helped hundreds of biopharma and biotech innovators validate and accelerate their preclinical and clinical therapeutic and biomarker programmes.
As a trusted CRO, we combine ready access to high-quality human biospecimens across multiple disease indications with deep scientific expertise to deliver data that de-risks development, cuts clinical attrition, and enables insightful therapeutic decisions.
Our scientific team consults closely with your team to design customised studies supporting validation of targets and biomarkers, disease characterisation, and profiling therapeutic candidates, then executes using advanced spatial and cellular biology models.
Through our collaborative approach, we act as an extension of your team, delivering tailored solutions on time and on budget.
By uniting state-of-the-art platforms with decades of know-how, we don’t just generate robust, compliant data — we provide scientific insights, establish deep partnerships, and help our clients to make a real impact on human health.

Name: SEALEO
Description:
Sealeo is a bio-based, plastic-free alternative to single-use thermal packaging in pharmaceutical logistics. We are on a mission to decarbonise the sector and phase out materials that have dominated for 35 years...expanded polystyrene (EPS) and gel packs. 
From a single seaweed precursor, we create two advanced solutions: a compostable biofoam insulation with 30% better thermal resistance than EPS, and a bio-coolant that maintains the 2–8 °C range. Together, they deliver superior performance while reducing plastic waste and enabling sustainable, regulation-ready medicine delivery at scale.

Name: Nutri-San
Description:
Nutri-San is a seaweed technology business first established in Vietnam in 2017.  We produce supplements made from a blend of natural seaweeds for the animal feed industry.  Our supplements improve animal health and food productivity and eliminate the need for the synthetic and pharmaceutically-derived additives commonly used in animal feeds. 
We are a company and a movement dedicated to protecting our environment and improving animal and human health.  Success for us means that people, animals and our planet flourish now and in the future.

Seaweed has been used for thousands of years to deliver health benefits for humans and animals.  Today these benefits are backed by science, yet seaweed remains one of the world's most underutilized resources.  


Nutri-San aims to change this by scaling a seaweed technology business that impacts some of the most pressing challenges we face globally - from combating climate change and feeding humans and animals better, to driving innovations in biotechnology, agriculture & medicine, and supporting marginalized coastal communities.  Our impact focus is closely aligned to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.  We are currently actively working towards SDGs 1, 3, 8, 13 and 14.

Name: Aila Biotech Ltd
Description: Aila Biotech harnesses a patented gene delivery technology to drive the production of immune-regulating biologics at the site of disease. Through the use of a delivery system allowing exquisite spatial and temporal control over biologic expression, Aila Biotech can prevent neuroinflammatory damage and pathology progression.

Name: Amped PCR
Description:
Amped PCR develops and supplies Amped Universal qPCR Master Mix.
A [5X] premium mastermix engineered for real-world labs and assay developers. Optimised for hydrolysis-probe (TaqMan) and intercalator dye workflows, SNP Genotyping, Microbiome, and Metagenomics studies using 16S rRNA Amplicon sequencing.
Amped Universal delivers antibody-mediated hot-start performance, exceptional tolerance to common inhibitors in crude templates, and dependable multiplexing with very low background contamination.

Designed for practical lab life, our mix supports room-temperature setup, scales from core labs to industrial workflows, and is shipped in eco-conscious, letterbox-friendly packaging (no dry ice) with practical pack sizes. Independent and internal studies demonstrate performance on par with leading commercial mixes.

Backed by commercial support and an ISO-aligned quality system, Amped PCR is focused on making high-performance reagents accessible, reproducible and easy to integrate. Purchase direct from the Amped Store or contact us to discuss distributor and enterprise options: ben@ampedpcr.co.uk

Name: Oxford Expression Technologies
Description:
Recombinant protein expression - industry leading yield, quality and service

Oxford Expression Technologies is a biotechnology company and centre of excellence for recombinant protein expression. We offer enhanced protein yield and quality coupled with top quality service. We offer a popular protein production service and a range of vectors for use in your own lab. We developed the patented flashBAC recombinant protein expression vectors, which are genetically optimised for improved protein production. We constantly innovate and are introducing new products and services, such as production of VLP vaccines and new cell lines for enhanced protein expression.

Name: Axitan
Description: Axitan is a UK biotech company focused on eliminating antibiotics from animal feed and improving productivity. It is developing a library of endolysins, and associated products, capable of targeting those pathogens that impact livestock farming historically managed through antibiotic supplements in animal feed and, in so doing, improve productivityyields. Its focus forms part of wider WHO One Health initiative to combat the threat posed by antimicrobial resistance caused by the overuse of antibiotics, animals accounting for two thirds of the antibiotics consumed globally each year. In October 2022, Axitan achieved US FDA GRAS (“Generally Recognised As Safe”) status for the algal biomass ingredient used in its first product, FORC3, which promotes healthy growth in poultry by targeting the pathogen Clostridium perfringens that causes $6b of economic loss each year to the poultry industry. Axitan has operations in the UK and US.

Name: VacV Biotherapeutics
Description: VacV Biotherapeutics is a cancer immunotherapy company developing innovative viral-based therapies for cancers. Launched in 2022 by cancer immunotherapy pioneers Professor Yaohe Wang, Professor Nicholas Lemoine, Dr. Louisa Chard Dunmall and Dr. Peng Liu, VacV employs a unique approach to immunotherapy based on the Vaccinia virus to stimulate a patient’s immune system to fight cancer while simultaneously destroying cancer cells. This approach offers many advantages over existing immunotherapies, including minimized toxicity, higher specificity and efficacy, allowing for efficient systemic delivery of an immunotherapy for the first time.

Name: Oyster Venture Partners
Description:
Oyster Venture Partners is a next-generation advisory firm that supports life science, healthcare and digital health companies with their capital raising and exit strategies.

Our first-hand experience in these sectors has enabled us to establish a new approach to fundraising that provides the necessary sector and transaction skillsets required for these cutting edge sectors. Further, we have developed a proprietary data set of the global investor which we believe will provide wider and faster access to capital.

Our mission is to support companies in preparing, connecting and raising capital from a global pre-validated pool of investors, whose sector experience and expertise will improve funding success rates and provide much-needed support to entrepreneurs and their mission to make an impact in healthcare.

Name: BlueGreen Clinical Ltd
Description:
BlueGreen Clinical is a specialist service provider and consultancy in clinical operations & compliance supporting biotech companies as they put fit-for-purpose GCP processes and systems in place to run clinical trials well.

We work alongside clients on the practical foundations of clinical operations, from strategy and sponsor oversight to the day-to-day processes, tools and logistics needed to be ready as a clinical trial sponsor.

A key area where we support clients is the implementation of GCP-focused SOPs within an eQMS (electronic Quality Management System), helping put in place the compliant operational framework needed before regulated clinical trial activities begin.

Clients typically come to us when they are preparing for their first clinical study (12-18 months before study start), scaling their clinical operations, strengthening sponsor oversight, checking for GCP gaps, or getting ready for due diligence or inspection. With more than 40 years of combined experience in biotech clinical operations, we offer practical expertise that helps teams feel better prepared and more confident as they move forward.

If you need experienced, practical support to build or strengthen your clinical operations foundations, we would be glad to talk.

Name: TeslaDiagnostiX
Description: We develop Lab-on-Chip based diagnostics for biomedical and industrial applications

Name: Duke Street Bio
Description: Duke Street Bio is focused on exploiting tumour genetic vulnerabilities and harnessing the natural power of the body’s immune system to fight cancer.

Name: Sentinel Oncology Limited
Description:
Founded in 2005 in Cambridge UK, Sentinel Oncology is dedicated to the development and commercialization of new therapeutics
Our core strength is the development of highly selective and targeted oncology candidate drugs. Our pipeline strategy is focused on the design and optimisation of new drugs which can be used to treat primary brain tumours or systemic tumours which frequently spread to the brain.

Name: Cardiff Medicentre
Description:
Medicentre is a successful joint-venture between Cardiff University and Cardiff and Vale University Health Board. Name: Ailurus Bio
Description: Ailurus Bio is a pioneering company building biological programs, genetic instructions that act as living software to orchestrate biology. We develop foundational DNAs and libraries, transforming lab-grown cells into living instruments that streamline complex research and production workflows. We empower scientists and developers worldwide with these bioprograms, accelerating discovery and diverse applications. Our mission is to make biology the truly general-purpose technology, as programmable and accessible as modern computers, by constructing a biocomputer architecture for all.

Description: QuberTech is transforming the natural rubber industry with innovative sustainable biotech solutions for a greener future

Name: Ziath from Azenta Life Sciences
Description: Ziath is now part of Azenta Life Sciences. Please visit the Azenta page for more exciting postings on life science subjects.

Name: Young Embryologist Network (YEN)
Description:
The Young Embryologist Network (YEN), is an academic body aiming to bring together early career scientists within the wide field of Developmental Biology. We provide opportunities to present talks and posters, network and collaborate, and gain research or career advice.

YEN was set up in 2008 by graduate students in the Department of Cell and Developmental Biology at University College London.  Every year, the YEN hosts a conference at a UK research institution with great success. 

The conference is entirely organised by graduate students and junior post-doctoral scientists, and has remained free to attend since 2008, due to the generosity of sponsors and grants.

The annual YEN conference is continually growing and expanding. Over 350 delegates registered for the 2022 conference, with many attendees from outside the UK. Since 2017, we have also been able to offer travel grants to support abstract-selected presentations from further afield.

Name: North Rode Scientific Services (NRSS) Ltd
Description:
North Rode Scientific Services offer Biotech/Pharma clients scientific, strategic, operational/project management & consultancy services in areas of Bioanalysis, Biomarkers & Biosample Operations. The focus of the company is to supply experienced individuals where clients lack expertise or sufficient capacity in these areas. 

• Program Management, Project/Outsourcing Manager for Bioanalysis and DMPK Studies
• Program and Project Manage all operational aspects of clinical biosample/specimens (PK/Biomarkers (soluble/tissue)) from study design concept, protocol design, implementation, study maintenance (specimen collection/processing, storage, shipping (central lab/analytical lab/biobank) and analysis) reporting and close out.
• Strategic or Tactical Outsourcing and Lab Selection(s) for bioanalysis and biomarkers (incl. c-labs)

• Facility (GLP/GCP) Inspections/Technical Audits
• Due Diligence/Data/Report Reviews

• Pre-clinical Toxicokinetic Evaluation and Interpretation
• DMPK/ADME Scientist, Data Interpretation and Summarisation
• Study Director/Principal Investigator

NRSS provide services to clients based in the UK, EU, US and China and are always looking to expand our client base and geographical reach. 

If you are interested in discussing how we can help, please email anthony.parry@nrss-ltd.com.

Name: MiCo BioMed
Description:
MiCo BioMed, founded in 2004, is focused on developing a next-generation diagnostics and life sciences platform using innovative microfluidics for immunoassays.

MiCo BioMed’s market-proven OptimiserTM technology integrates the power of microfluidics into easy-to-use high- medium- and low-throughput platforms, as well as allows for manual testing using the same assay disposables. Over 70 assays have been developed using the OptimiserTM technology platform, proving the robustness and universal nature of this platform.

MiCo BioMed invites diagnostic and life science companies to learn about our OptimiserTM technology.

Our proven OptimiserTM microfluidic platform is already commercially offered to the life science market. It provides users unheard-of enhancements in automation workflow and improved assay throughput. ELISAs use sample sizes of less than a drop of blood (3 to 5 uL). OptimiserTM technology allows users to tune their assay, typically with no change in their own or commercially available reagents.

Name: Esya Labs
Description:
Esya's DNA probes can ratiometrically quantify ions within endocytic organelles such as Endosomes & Lysosomes, for diseases such as COVID-19, Lysosomal Storage Disorders & Alzheimer's Disease. We are a precision biomarker company providing groundbreaking molecular insights to facilitate drug discovery, diagnostics, and personalized medicine, by profiling ion signatures within key organelles.  
 
By chemically profiling various biological markers, such as lysosomal ion signatures, our technologies can help decode the underpinnings of a number of different diseases, as well as test potential drug treatments and therapies.

Name: ISOgenix Limited
Description: We are an Oxford University spin-out developing breakthrough therapies for the treatment of ALS and other neurodegenerative diseases. Our approach builds upon novel protein isoform insights identified using our state-of-the-art technologies including long read sequencing and proprietary bioinformatics pipelines. Our founding team has decades of experience in the field of precision medicines, and we have an unwavering focus on developing novel therapies for patients. We are based in Oxford, UK (www.isogenixtx.com).

Name: NWPHARMATECH LTD
Description:
NWPharmaTech is a Clinical Stage Biotech Company with a focus on Psychiatric & Neurological Disorders.

Our expert team combines academic research, cutting-edge technology and clinical development to bring to market new drug formulations targeting mental health conditions.

These therapeutic interventions will support a return to homeostasis, empowering patients to lead longer and healthier lives.

Name: 10zyme
Description:
We are redefining cervical screening

10zyme is engineering biology to develop an innovative diagnostic technology that will empower women to effectively control their cervical health.

As an early-stage UK MedTech startup, we are pioneering a visionary approach to cervical screening. Our unique self-test will deliver instant results for high-risk HPV, the virus responsible for over 99% of all cervical cancers.

Self-test vs. self-collection

10zyme’s self-testing solution will provide immediate, reliable results wherever and whenever the test is taken. In comparison, self-collection/ sampling methods developed elsewhere only offer an alternative means of sample collection that still require transportation and laboratory testing, therefore leading to delays in obtaining results.

Self-testing will significantly increase screening uptake whilst reducing strain on vital healthcare resources, providing an accessible, convenient, and life-saving cancer prevention solution to all.

Benefits of our HPV self-test with instant results:

• Non-invasive and simple to use
• Provides sensitive and accurate results compared to lab-based tests
• Increases cervical screening uptake
• Reduces strain on vital healthcare resources
• Provides an accessible, convenient, and life-saving cancer prevention solution to all

Name: ComeInCell
Description:
EU Horizon Europe Funded Doctoral Network


COndensates at Membrane Scaffolds – INtegrated Systems as Synthetic CELL Compartments (ComeInCell)

ComeInCell is a European Doctoral Network at the forefront of synthetic cell research. Our mission is to develop advanced cellular mimics that integrate functional membrane structures and biomolecular condensates. By creating these next-generation synthetic cells, we aim to shed light on complex cellular mechanisms, particularly those involved in neurodegenerative diseases and membrane trafficking, as well as accelerate drug discovery and therapeutic innovation.

This ambitious project brings together a diverse team of experts in biophysics, nanotechnology, biochemistry, and bioengineering. Our doctoral candidates will receive interdisciplinary training, gaining hands-on experience with state-of-the-art methodologies and working closely with both academic institutions and industry partners.

Through ComeInCell, we’re not just advancing scientific knowledge – we’re cultivating a new generation of quantitative synthetic biologists equipped to tackle global challenges in biomedical research and biotechnology. Join us as we explore the fascinating interface between membranes and condensates, paving the way for novel therapeutic strategies and research tools!

ComeInCell is a European project funded by the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions. DN. It is also co-funded by UK Guarantee Scheme.

Name: Talent Therapeutics

Description:
Founded in 1996 by a group of highly experienced healthcare professionals with a wide range of pharmaceutical industry and academic experience, The Micron Group has grown around this core of expertise, and now has offices in the UK, USA and South Africa.

From these locations The Micron Group has global capabilities to deliver full clinical outsourcing , data management, medical communications and consultancy services.

While initially an anti-infective specialized organisation, and still an authority in this field, The Micron Group has evolved to posses the expertise required to deliver our full range of services in the fields of  respiratory, cardiovascular, neurology, dermatology, endocrinology, rheumatology, and oncology.

Regardless of the field or the project, The Micron Group consistently strives to deliver a service that is flexible, preemptive and precise, ensuring projects are delivered on time and on budget, while going above and beyond expectation.

Name: RAFT Energy
Description:
RAFT Energy combines innovative biotechnology, advanced chemistry, and real-time monitoring to turn waste into wealth—starting with cutting‐edge biogas optimisation via ActiCH4RTM and expanding into smarter resource management with ActiSense.

Our products, including ActiCH4RTM for next‐generation biogas support and ActiSense for intelligent feed control, work together to stabilise complex biology, unlock new value from waste, and cut emissions across energy, water, and beyond.

Name: BlueGnome
Description: BlueGnome is a specialist supplier of products from the investigation of genetic abnormalities associated with developmental delay, cancer and infertility. BlueGnome’s  24sure technology is widely used by IVF centers to selectively implant chromosomally normally embryos and so improve IVF rates. BlueGnome is a winner of the Queens Award for Innovation and has won multiple awards as one of the UK’s fastest growing biotechs.

Name: UKEV - United Kingdom Society for Extracellular Vesicles
Description: We support the development of extracellular vesicle education & research across the UK.

Name: Protium Technologies
Description:
Protium Technologies is a UK and UAE startup company mainly focusing on sustainable green energy for the future and the meaningful use of hydrogen.
We are currently developing the world's first (net-zero emission) BioHydrogen powertrain concept for aviation and hard to decarbonise transportation segment in the UK through a novel enzymatic biohydrogen production pathway that can potentially generate a high yield of biohydrogen from a lightweight waste substrate achieving a theoretical gravimetric ratio of %15.32 at normal ambient conditions.

We are also developing a novel sustainable wastewater treatment system in the UAE in collaboration with SRTIP (Sharjah Research Technology and Innovation Park) and the AUS (American University of Sharjah) to utilize renewable energies and green hydrogen in solving the RO reject wastewater challenge, paving the way for a sustainable wastewater recycling system.

In addition to our R&D work, we are aiming to be a significant player in the hydrogen economy, hence we’ve launched a commercial division as we intend to become a one-stop-shop for all hydrogen related products and projects, by introducing system integration solutions, obtaining products distribution rights for certain territories and provide consultancy services. 

Protium Technologies have been appointed as Nitto’s DX tapes distributor in the UK and the Middle East region.
Nitto DX tapes series consist of: Hydrogen detection tapes, Ammonia Detection tapes and CO2 detection tapes.

Name: ABMIUM
Description:
ABMIUM is building the evidence and trust layer for RUO (Research Use Only) life science procurement.

Right now, labs and procurement teams are forced to make purchasing decisions on antibodies, ELISA kits, proteins, and molecular reagents using fragmented, inconsistent, and often non-comparable validation data.
The result is predictable: irreproducibility, wasted budgets, lost time, and delayed discoveries.

ABMIUM is changing that.

We provide standardised, decision-grade evidence packs that show:

• What was tested
• What worked and what did not
• The experimental conditions that matter
• How to interpret the data for real-world purchasing decisions

Rather than rebranding or repackaging products, ABMIUM partners directly with original manufacturers through a co-branding and verification model.
We carry out structured due diligence, contextualise performance data, and publish it transparently, raising market standards through clarity, accountability, and evidence-based decision making.

Our goal is simple:

Faster purchasing decisions.
Reduced experimental risk.
A stronger link between scientific performance and procurement.

ABMIUM does not add more noise to the market.
We make the signal clearer.

If you are a manufacturer, research group, procurement team, or stakeholder who believes life science purchasing should be driven by better evidence, clearer standards, and greater trust, we would welcome the conversation.

Name: Cellmark - DNA Relationship Testing
Description: Cellmark pioneered the introduction of DNA analysis for paternity testing. We use the most conclusive 24 marker genetic test across our range of DNA relationship testing services. That includes DNA testing for - Paternity, Maternity, Sibling, Avuncular, Grandparentage and Immigration matters as well. Contact us for court approved and accredited relationship testing.

Name: Base Genomics
Description:
Base Genomics aims to have a major impact on personalised medicine. We are developing TAPS, a breakthrough technology from the University of Oxford that makes epigenetic analysis of DNA methylation more sensitive, accurate and cheaper than ever before. We aim to transform healthcare by enabling early and precise detection of cancer. Long-term, we expect TAPS to become central to a host of major new healthcare and research applications.

*We are hiring*

We are looking for talented chemists, enzymologists, protein engineers, NGS specialists, bioinformaticians and software developers at all levels. Check out the available roles at basegenomics.com/join-us

Description: Our founders were pioneers of monoclonal antibody therapy, bringing to the clinic the first humanised antibody, the first made in CHO cells, the first bispecific and the first aglycosylated antibody.  Now we have developed a new Fc variant which is more comprehensively silenced than previous antibodies. It is able to reduce unwanted inflammatory responses from the next generation of antibody-based drugs. We are building partnerships with Universities, Biotech and Pharma companies to make this new technology widely available.

Name: UTILITY therapeutics (Acquired by Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc.)
Description:
UTILITY therapeutics Ltd., a biotechnology company focused on the U.S. development and commercialization of two European-approved antibiotics for the treatment of urinary tract infections (UTI, to address the significant threat faced by healthcare systems and patients from multi-drug resistant bacterial infections. The World Health Organisation has stated that antibiotic resistance is one of the biggest threats to global health, food security, and development today.

Pivmecillinam is an oral prodrug of mecillinam that is being developed for uncomplicated UTI (uUTI), and it has a unique mechanism of action for infections caused by Gram-negative bacteria, including extended-spectrum beta-lactamases. Mecillinam, an intravenous (IV) formulation, is being developed as a first-line therapy for complicated UTI (cUTI) in the hospital setting.

Name: Providion Group
Description:
Providion is a leading independent provider of innovative training & service solutions for LC-MS systems. We specialise in the service & support of Waters/ Micromass & Applied Biosystems/ Sciex equipment.

Our team of product experts delivers everything from technical training courses, preventative maintenance visits to full service contracts.  We offer technical support, quality spare parts, refurbished instruments, factory repairs and rapid response to instrument breakdowns.  We are proud to support many large pharmaceutical companies, contract research organisations, universities and drug discovery businesses as part of our expanding customer base.

Offering annual service contracts, preventive maintenance and repairs tailored to your needs we keep instrument uptime as a priority for all our customers worldwide.

Based in Manchester, Providion's head office, laboratory and training centre, Spectrum House, is home to our knowledgeable and friendly sales and administration team. In our well equipped workshops and audited repair facilities our in-house engineers expertly fix and system test instruments to component level.  We are able to demonstrate our latest refurbished equipment and provide customised technical and user training courses for all levels of expertise. 
Our locations in Ontario, Canada and Georgia, USA extend that support and service delivery for our North American clients offering the same level of quality for contracts, repairs, parts and instrument sales.

Providion is committed to assisting customers with their unique needs by providing them with comprehensive, quality assured solutions and professional, personal service.

Name: CamGene Therapeutics
Description:
The WHO predicts hearing loss will impact 1 in 10 people by 2050. Medical devices are the standard of care, but they are ineffective for many people.

Despite a prevalence greater than cancer or diabetes, there are currently no treatments available to treat the underlying cellular dysfunction which is the root cause of hearing loss.

Lipid nanoparticle-based mRNA therapeutics were spectacularly validated as a mass market medicine through the COVID-19 pandemic. We believe the time is now to create the world’s first mass market medicine for hearing loss.

Name: Virustatic SHIELD
Description: SHIELD yourself. Experts in Lactoferrin. IMMUNE SHIELD, science-backed supplements with potent lactoferrin and vitamin C, will transform your health and immunity from the inside out. The Virustatic Shield: Patented Innovation Award Winning viral filtration materials
